_comment: 原創翻譯層：上游模組自帶 EN 文本但 As1 未收錄的鍵。人工真相檔（手編或工作流生成後人工審核）。
_usage: schema：entries.<檔名>.<鍵> = {en, ch, cn}。en=擷取當時上游原文（供過時比對）；ch=直寫繁中台灣用語（不經 OpenCC）；cn=直寫簡中大陸用語（**同樣不經 OpenCC，不得由 ch 機轉產生**）。與 As1 同鍵時 As1 優先，build 會提示退役該條目。

我們的醫療物資快用完了, 情況每小時都在惡化. 傷口正在感染, 高燒退不下來, 傷患的狀況我們也穩不住多久了. 如果您能幫忙, 請盡快把下列物品送到這個地點:

數量 : %s
物品 : %s
地點 : %s

無論您如何決定, 都感謝您讀完這封信.
在外頭要活下去.
— %s
IGUI_PZLinux_MailMedical_1.cn:
%s 您好,
我们的医疗物资快用完了, 情况每小时都在恶化. 伤口正在感染, 高烧退不下来, 伤患的状况我们也稳不住多久了. 如果您能帮忙, 请尽快把下列物品送到这个地点:

数量 : %s
物品 : %s
地点 : %s

无论您如何决定, 都感谢您读完这封信.
在外头要活下去.
— %s

IGUI_PZLinux_MailMedical_2.en:
Hello %s,
I’m writing with shaking hands. We have survivors here—some hurt, some sick—and we’re down to almost nothing. If you have any spare meds, please bring them quickly. Even a small amount could save lives.

Quantity : %s
Object : %s
Location : %s

We owe you, even if you can’t make it.
— %s
IGUI_PZLinux_MailMedical_2.ch:
%s 您好,
我寫這封信時手還在發抖. 這裡有一群倖存者, 有的受傷, 有的生病, 而我們的物資幾乎見底. 如果您有多餘的藥品, 請盡快送來. 就算只有一點點, 也能救人一命.

數量 : %s
物品 : %s
地點 : %s

就算您趕不過來, 我們也欠您一份人情.
— %s
IGUI_PZLinux_MailMedical_2.cn:
%s 您好,
我写这封信时手还在发抖. 这里有一群幸存者, 有的受伤, 有的生病, 而我们的物资几乎见底. 如果您有多余的药品, 请尽快送来. 就算只有一点点, 也能救人一命.

数量 : %s
物品 : %s
地点 : %s

就算您赶不过来, 我们也欠您一份人情.
— %s

IGUI_PZLinux_MailMedical_3.en:
Hello %s,
We thought we could manage on bandages and luck. We were wrong. Pain is constant, infections are spreading, and we’re out of proper medication. If you’re still out there and able, please deliver:

Quantity : %s
Object : %s
Location : %s

No pressure—just… hope.
— %s
IGUI_PZLinux_MailMedical_3.ch:
%s 您好,
我們原以為靠繃帶和運氣就能撐過去. 我們錯了. 疼痛從沒停過, 感染不斷擴散, 而正規藥品已經用完. 如果您還在外頭而且有辦法, 請送來:

數量 : %s
物品 : %s
地點 : %s

不勉強您, 只是… 抱著一線希望.
— %s
IGUI_PZLinux_MailMedical_3.cn:
%s 您好,
我们原以为靠绷带和运气就能撑过去. 我们错了. 疼痛从没停过, 感染不断扩散, 而正规药品已经用完. 如果您还在外头而且有办法, 请送来:

数量 : %s
物品 : %s
地点 : %s

不勉强您, 只是… 抱着一线希望.
— %s

Print_Text_ListerineConvenience_info.en: Whether you keep it in your car glovebox or in your back pocket, Listerine keeps your mouth minty fresh for ANYTHING!
Print_Text_ListerineConvenience_info.ch: 不管是放在車上的置物箱還是後口袋, 李施德霖都能讓你的口氣保持薄荷清新, 隨時應付任何場合!
Print_Text_ListerineConvenience_info.cn: 不管是放在车上的储物箱还是后口袋, 李施德林都能让你的口气保持薄荷清新, 随时应付任何场合!

Print_Text_ListerineConvenience_title.ch: 李施德霖讓你口氣薄荷清新!
Print_Text_ListerineConvenience_title.cn: 李施德林让你口气薄荷清新!

Print_Text_Fortune10_info.ch: 「一步一步走, 也能走得很遠.」
Print_Text_Fortune10_info.cn: “一步一步走, 也能走得很远.”

Print_Text_Fortune2_info.en: 'Live this day as if it were your last.'
Print_Text_Fortune2_info.ch: 「把今天當成生命的最後一天來過.」
Print_Text_Fortune2_info.cn: “把今天当成生命的最后一天来过.”

Print_Text_Fortune3_info.en: 'There are no regrets in life. Just lessons.'
Print_Text_Fortune3_info.ch: 「人生沒有後悔, 只有教訓.」
Print_Text_Fortune3_info.cn: “人生没有后悔, 只有教训.”

Print_Text_Fortune8_info.en: 'What's the point of being if you're not being yourself?'
Print_Text_Fortune8_info.ch: 「若不能做自己, 活著又有什麼意義?」
Print_Text_Fortune8_info.cn: “若不能做自己, 活着又有什么意义?”

Print_Text_Fortune9_info.en: 'What good are wings, without the courage to fly.'
Print_Text_Fortune9_info.ch: 「沒有飛翔的勇氣, 翅膀又有何用.」
Print_Text_Fortune9_info.cn: “没有飞翔的勇气, 翅膀又有何用.”

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.en: Ideal Weight Lose Grace Period Hours Speed Multiplier
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.ch: 理想體重失去寬限時數累積倍率
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.cn: 理想体重失去宽限小时数累积倍率

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.en: How fast you earn 'grace period' hours that later are used up before you lose the trait if you're not between 75-85 weight. Default multiplier of 1 earns you 1 grace period hour for every 12h of keeping weight 78-82 (Basically 0.0834 grace hours for each 1h). Higher multiplier = faster gain of grace hours. Lower multiplier = slower gain of grace hours.
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.ch: 你累積寬限時數的速度; 當體重不在75-85之間時, 這些時數會先被消耗, 用完後才會失去此特質. 預設倍率1代表體重維持在78-82時, 每12小時累積1小時寬限時數 (即每1小時約累積0.0834小時). 倍率越高, 寬限時數累積越快; 倍率越低則累積越慢.
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.cn: 你积累宽限小时数的速度; 当体重不在75-85之间时, 这些小时数会先被消耗, 用完后才会失去此特质. 默认倍率1代表体重保持在78-82时, 每12小时积累1小时宽限小时数 (即每1小时约积累0.0834小时). 倍率越高, 宽限小时数积累越快; 倍率越低则积累越慢.

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightLos.en: Ideal Weight Lose Grace Period Cap
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightLos.ch: 理想體重失去寬限時數上限
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightLos.cn: 理想体重失去宽限小时数上限

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightLos.en: How many hours can you 'earn' on counter that later will be used before you lose your Ideal Weight trait if your weight is not between 75-85
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightLos.ch: 計數器上最多可以累積多少小時; 當你的體重不在75-85之間時, 這些時數會先被消耗, 之後才會失去理想體重特質
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightLos.cn: 计数器上最多可以积累多少小时; 当你的体重不在75-85之间时, 这些小时数会先被消耗, 之后才会失去理想体重特质

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightObt.en: How many hours you can be not between 78-82 weight while earning the trait and not reset your progress. Check is made every in-game hour.
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightObt.ch: 在累積獲得此特質的進度期間, 你的體重可以有多少小時不在78-82之間而不重置進度. 每遊戲內一小時檢查一次.
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightObt.cn: 在积累获得此特质的进度期间, 你的体重可以有多少小时不在78-82之间而不重置进度. 每游戏内一小时检查一次.

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightTar.cn: 理想体重获得所需天数

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightTar.cn: 你必须把体重保持在78到82之间多少天才能获得此特质. 每游戏内一小时检查一次.

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_UnwaveringCoun.en: This is internal counter that needs to be reached before you get the trait. Each injury below belt adds to counter every 10 min. Deep Wound > Laceration > Burn/Fracture > Scratch > Bleeding. For example, having burns on 1 bodypart below belt would result in getting around +2.3 on counter in 24h. Having 1 fracture gives around +3 in 24h.
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_UnwaveringCoun.ch: 這是需要達到的內部計數器數值, 達到後才會獲得此特質. 腰部以下的每處傷勢每10分鐘都會增加計數. 深傷口 > 撕裂傷 > 燒傷/骨折 > 抓傷 > 流血. 例如, 腰部以下1個身體部位有燒傷, 24小時內計數器約+2.3; 有1處骨折則24小時約+3.
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_UnwaveringCoun.cn: 这是需要达到的内部计数器数值, 达到后才会获得此特质. 腰部以下的每处伤势每10分钟都会增加计数. 深伤口 > 撕裂伤 > 烧伤/骨折 > 抓伤 > 流血. 例如, 腰部以下1个身体部位有烧伤, 24小时内计数器约+2.3; 有1处骨折则24小时约+3.

Sandbox_XVirus_AdminSpawnOnly_tooltip.en: When enabled, the X-Virus will not spawn in loot anywhere. Only admins can spawn it via the item picker or /additem. Useful for servers that want the virus available but tightly controlled. Changes take effect after a server restart.
Sandbox_XVirus_AdminSpawnOnly_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, X病毒不會出現在任何戰利品中. 只有管理員能透過物品選擇器或 /additem 生成它. 適合想保留此病毒但嚴格控管的伺服器. 變更會在伺服器重新啟動後生效.
Sandbox_XVirus_AdminSpawnOnly_tooltip.cn: 启用后, X病毒不会出现在任何战利品中. 只有管理员能通过物品选择器或 /additem 生成它. 适合想保留此病毒但严格管控的服务器. 变更会在服务器重新启动后生效.

Sandbox_XVirus_AlreadyInfected_tooltip.en: What happens when a player uses the X-Virus while already infected. No Effect = virus is wasted. Grant Mutations = grants mutation traits without re-infecting.
Sandbox_XVirus_AlreadyInfected_tooltip.ch: 玩家在已感染狀態下使用 X病毒時的結果. 無效果 = 浪費一劑病毒. 授予突變 = 不重新感染, 僅授予突變特質.
Sandbox_XVirus_AlreadyInfected_tooltip.cn: 玩家在已感染状态下使用 X病毒时的结果. 无效果 = 浪费一剂病毒. 授予突变 = 不重新感染, 仅授予突变特质.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitCorpses_tooltip.en: Grants immunity to stress from corpses on injection. Re-injecting with different settings updates the trait. Random = coin flip per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitCorpses_tooltip.ch: 注射後可免疫屍體造成的壓力. 以不同設定重新注射會更新該特質. 隨機 = 每位玩家各擲一次硬幣決定.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitCorpses_tooltip.cn: 注射后可免疫尸体造成的压力. 以不同设置重新注射会更新该特质. 随机 = 每位玩家各掷一次硬币决定.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitDexterity_tooltip.en: Modifies item transfer speed on injection. Dextrous = 2x faster. All Thumbs = 2x slower. Random = picks one per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitDexterity_tooltip.ch: 注射後改變物品搬運速度. 眼疾手快 = 快 2 倍. 笨手笨腳 = 慢 2 倍. 隨機 = 每位玩家各挑一項.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitDexterity_tooltip.cn: 注射后改变物品搬运速度. 眼疾手快 = 快 2 倍. 笨手笨脚 = 慢 2 倍. 随机 = 每位玩家各挑一项.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitFear_tooltip.en: Modifies fear response on injection. Brave = halved stress. Cowardly = doubled stress. Random = picks one per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitFear_tooltip.ch: 注射後改變恐懼反應. 無所畏懼 = 壓力減半. 畏首畏尾 = 壓力加倍. 隨機 = 每位玩家各挑一項.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitFear_tooltip.cn: 注射后改变恐惧反应. 无所畏惧 = 压力减半. 畏首畏尾 = 压力加倍. 随机 = 每位玩家各挑一项.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitLearning_tooltip.en: Modifies research speed on injection. Fast = 30% faster. Slow = 30% slower. Random = picks one per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitLearning_tooltip.ch: 注射後改變研究速度. 快 = 加快 30%%. 慢 = 減慢 30%%. 隨機 = 每位玩家各挑一項.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitLearning_tooltip.cn: 注射后改变研究速度. 快 = 加快 30%%. 慢 = 减慢 30%%. 随机 = 每位玩家各挑一项.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitReading_tooltip.en: Modifies reading speed on injection. Fast = 30% faster. Slow = 30% slower. Random = picks one per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitReading_tooltip.ch: 注射後改變閱讀速度. 快 = 加快 30%%. 慢 = 減慢 30%%. 隨機 = 每位玩家各挑一項.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitReading_tooltip.cn: 注射后改变阅读速度. 快 = 加快 30%%. 慢 = 减慢 30%%. 随机 = 每位玩家各挑一项.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitVision_tooltip.en: Grants wider vision arc on injection. Re-injecting with different settings updates the trait. Random = coin flip per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitVision_tooltip.ch: 注射後獲得更寬的視野範圍. 以不同設定重新注射會更新該特質. 隨機 = 每位玩家各擲一次硬幣決定.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitVision_tooltip.cn: 注射后获得更宽的视野范围. 以不同设置重新注射会更新该特质. 随机 = 每位玩家各掷一次硬币决定.

Sandbox_XVirus_VirusRarity_tooltip.en: Controls how often the X-Virus spawns in loot. Common = 2x spawn rate, Uncommon = 1x, Rare = 0.4x (default), Very Rare = 0.15x. Changes take effect after a server restart. Ignored if Admin Spawn Only is enabled.
Sandbox_XVirus_VirusRarity_tooltip.ch: 控制 X病毒在戰利品中出現的頻率. 常見 = 2 倍生成率, 不常見 = 1 倍, 稀少 = 0.4 倍 (預設), 非常稀少 = 0.15 倍. 變更會在伺服器重新啟動後生效. 若已啟用僅限管理員生成, 則忽略此設定.
Sandbox_XVirus_VirusRarity_tooltip.cn: 控制 X病毒在战利品中出现的频率. 常见 = 2 倍生成率, 不常见 = 1 倍, 稀少 = 0.4 倍 (默认), 非常稀少 = 0.15 倍. 变更会在服务器重新启动后生效. 若已启用仅限管理员生成, 则忽略此设置.

Sandbox_ammomaker_CraftingSpeed_tooltip.en: Adjust crafting speed for all Ammo Maker recipes
Sandbox_ammomaker_CraftingSpeed_tooltip.ch: 調整彈藥製造系統所有配方的製作速度.
Sandbox_ammomaker_CraftingSpeed_tooltip.cn: 调整弹药制造系统所有配方的制作速度.

Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_EnhancedRainEx.en: Rain now increases wetness progressively. Prolonged high wetness amplifies cold damage indirectly; rain does not cause direct illness.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_EnhancedRainEx.ch: 淋雨會逐漸提高潮濕度. 長時間維持高潮濕度會間接放大寒冷造成的傷害; 雨水本身不會直接致病.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_EnhancedRainEx.cn: 淋雨会逐渐提高潮湿度. 长时间维持高潮湿度会间接放大寒冷造成的伤害; 雨水本身不会直接致病.

Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_LightningAttra.en: If true, lightning strikes emit a strong world sound that attracts zombies like a global meta event. Default: off.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_LightningAttra.ch: 啟用時, 落雷會發出強烈的世界音效, 像全域事件一樣吸引殭屍. 預設: 停用.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_LightningAttra.cn: 启用时, 落雷会发出强烈的世界音效, 像全局事件一样吸引僵尸. 默认: 禁用.

Sandbox_Printer3D_EnablePrintingFailures.en: Allows 3D printers to suffer jams, print failures, and extrusion errors.
Sandbox_Printer3D_EnablePrintingFailures.ch: 允許3D印表機發生堵塞, 列印失敗與擠出錯誤.
Sandbox_Printer3D_EnablePrintingFailures.cn: 允许3D打印机发生堵塞, 打印失败与挤出错误.

Sandbox_Printer3D_PrintingFailureMultipl.en: Adjusts the chance of failures during printing.
Sandbox_Printer3D_PrintingFailureMultipl.ch: 調整列印過程中發生失敗的機率.
Sandbox_Printer3D_PrintingFailureMultipl.cn: 调整打印过程中发生失败的几率.

Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableGodRays_Too.en: When enabled, sun rays will be visually rendered on the screen during sunrise and sunset, depending on the sun's position.
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableGodRays_Too.ch: 啟用後, 日出與日落期間會依據太陽位置在畫面上繪製陽光光束.
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableGodRays_Too.cn: 启用后, 日出与日落期间会依据太阳位置在画面上绘制阳光光束.

Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableStormMood_T.en: When enabled, storms can push a cinematic desaturation + darker ambient mood (with smooth fade).
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableStormMood_T.ch: 啟用後, 暴風雨可帶來電影感的降低飽和度與更陰暗的環境氛圍 (含平滑淡入淡出).
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableStormMood_T.cn: 启用后, 暴风雨可带来电影感的降低饱和度与更阴暗的环境氛围 (含平滑淡入淡出).

Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset.ch: 暴風雨氛圍去飽和預設
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset.cn: 暴风雨氛围去饱和预设

Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset_T.en: Choose how strong the storm desaturation should be: Soft, Recommended, Night of the Living Dead (Black & White).
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset_T.ch: 選擇暴風雨去飽和的強度: 柔和, 建議, 活死人之夜 (黑白).
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset_T.cn: 选择暴风雨去饱和的强度: 柔和, 建议, 活死人之夜 (黑白).

Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.ch: 對流過渡強度 (1.0 = 基礎)
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.cn: 对流过渡强度 (1.0 = 基础)

Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.en: Smoothes the warming-rate cliff right at normal body temperature. 1.0 is baseline. 0 disables the bridge, warming up from cold to normal feels fast, but heating past normal in hot air feels much slower.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.ch: 平滑正常體溫附近的升溫速率斷崖. 1.0 為基礎值. 0 會停用此過渡, 從寒冷回升到正常體溫感覺很快, 但在熱空氣中升到正常體溫以上則會慢得多.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.cn: 平滑正常体温附近的升温速率断崖. 1.0 为基础值. 0 会禁用此过渡, 从寒冷回升到正常体温感觉很快, 但在热空气中升到正常体温以上则会慢得多.

Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.ch: 各身體部位保溫偏重 (預設 0.30)
Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.cn: 各身体部位保温偏重 (默认 0.30)

Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.en: Controls how strongly uneven loadouts (e.g. parka + bare legs) deviate from the simple body-wide average. 0.0 = pure average (all parts treated equally); 1.0 = always pulled toward the weakest part in cold and the most-trapping part in heat. 0.30 is the recommended middle ground.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.ch: 控制不均衡的穿著 (例如厚外套 + 光著腿) 偏離全身平均值的程度. 0.0 = 純平均 (所有部位一視同仁); 1.0 = 寒冷時始終偏向最薄弱的部位, 炎熱時始終偏向最悶熱的部位. 0.30 是建議的折衷值.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.cn: 控制不均衡的穿着 (例如厚外套 + 光着腿) 偏离全身平均值的程度. 0.0 = 纯平均 (所有部位一视同仁); 1.0 = 寒冷时始终偏向最薄弱的部位, 炎热时始终偏向最闷热的部位. 0.30 是建议的折衷值.

Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM.ch: 升溫速率上限 (°C 每分鐘)
Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM.cn: 升温速率上限 (°C 每分钟)

Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM_.en: Hard ceiling on how fast body temperature can rise from environmental warming (warm air, heaters, hot drinks combined). 0.5 °C/min is the default. Lower for slower recovery from cold; raise for instant warm-up at fires.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM_.ch: 體溫因環境加溫 (暖空氣, 暖爐, 熱飲的綜合作用) 而上升速度的硬性上限. 預設為 0.5 °C/分鐘. 調低可讓從寒冷中恢復得更慢; 調高則可在火堆旁瞬間回暖.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM_.cn: 体温因环境加温 (暖空气, 暖炉, 热饮的综合作用) 而上升速度的硬性上限. 默认为 0.5 °C/分钟. 调低可让从寒冷中恢复得更慢; 调高则可在火堆旁瞬间回暖.

Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnAnimals.ch: 第六感特質對動物生效
Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnAnimals.cn: 第六感特质对动物生效

Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnZombies.ch: 第六感特質對殭屍生效
Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnZombies.cn: 第六感特质对丧尸生效

Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnZombies.en: That's the point of the mod, right !?
Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnZombies.ch: 這就是這個模組的重點, 對吧!?
Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnZombies.cn: 这就是这个模组的重点, 对吧!?

Sandbox_DAMN_AllowSuckyMcSuckfaceSpawns.en: Enable preset '93 Ford CF-8000 Elgin Street Sweeper spawns
Sandbox_DAMN_AllowSuckyMcSuckfaceSpawns.ch: 啟用預設93款福特CF8000 Elgin街道清掃車生成
Sandbox_DAMN_AllowSuckyMcSuckfaceSpawns.cn: 启用预设93款福特CF8000 Elgin街道清扫车生成

Sandbox_NLKAlwaysKnowRoads_tooltip.en: New Characters start with knowledge of their immediate location and Kentucky's Roads.
Sandbox_NLKAlwaysKnowRoads_tooltip.ch: 新角色一開始就知曉自身所在區域與肯塔基州的道路.
Sandbox_NLKAlwaysKnowRoads_tooltip.cn: 新角色一开始就知晓自身所在区域与肯塔基州的道路.

Sandbox_HB_CasingSounds_tooltip.en: Enable sounds for casings hitting the floor.

Sandbox_DTEM_EnablePillsTraitsDevelopmen.en: Enable being able to develop Nervous Wreck and Melancholic during the game.
Sandbox_DTEM_EnablePillsTraitsDevelopmen.ch: 啟用遊戲中可養成「神經緊繃」與「鬱鬱寡歡」特質
Sandbox_DTEM_EnablePillsTraitsDevelopmen.cn: 启用游戏中可养成“神经紧绷”与“郁郁寡欢”特质

Sandbox_BWardrobe.Cropped.cn: 禁用容器生成: 短款上衣

Sandbox_BWardrobe.Dress_tooltip.cn:
取消勾选此选项后, 连衣裙将不再出现于世界中

Affects how quickly resistant antibodies eliminate the zombie virus from the body after activation in the stage.
-This trait is acquired by injecting the level 4 vaccine;

Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchRand.cn: 研究 - 进度加成. 数值:

Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchRand_tooltip.en:
Only works for the vaccine improvement research type "PROGRESSIVE CHANCE" and "FULL RESEARCH"!
-In case of failed research, increases the result by a randomizer depending on this number (hereafter referred to as X);
-The formula works as:
Rand(X, X*2) for research up to level 2;
Rand(X*0.75, X*1.5) for research up to level 3;
Rand(X*0.5, X) for research up to level 4!
-Rounded up to the nearest whole number;
-Simply put: the randomizer decreases for researching a new vaccine by ~30% on average.
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchRand_tooltip.ch:
僅對疫苗改良研究類型「累進機率」與「完整研究」有效!
-研究失敗時, 會依此數值 (以下稱為 X) 以隨機值提升結果;
-公式如下:
研究至第 2 級為 Rand(X, X*2);
研究至第 3 級為 Rand(X*0.75, X*1.5);
研究至第 4 級為 Rand(X*0.5, X)!
-結果無條件進位為整數;
-簡單來說: 研究更高等級疫苗時, 隨機值平均約降低 30%%.
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchRand_tooltip.cn:
仅对疫苗改良研究类型“累进几率”与“完整研究”有效!
-研究失败时, 会依此数值 (以下称为 X) 以随机值提升结果;
-公式如下:
研究至第 2 级为 Rand(X, X*2);
研究至第 3 级为 Rand(X*0.75, X*1.5);
研究至第 4 级为 Rand(X*0.5, X)!
-结果向上取整为整数;
-简单来说: 研究更高等级疫苗时, 随机值平均约降低 30%%.

Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType_tooltip.en:
Choice of result type for improving (researching) new vaccine levels.
-PROGRESSIVE CHANCE - on failure, the next success chance increases (accumulates);
-STATIC CHANCE - fixed percentage chance of success (30,20,14% from second to fourth);
-FULL RESEARCH - there is a hidden progress bar for study (100 units, conditionally, each research fills the bar).
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType_tooltip.ch:
改良 (研究) 新疫苗等級時的結果判定類型.
-累進機率 - 失敗時, 下一次的成功機率會提升 (可累積);
-固定機率 - 固定的成功百分比 (第二至第四級分別為 30, 20, 14%%);
-完整研究 - 存在一條隱藏的研究進度條 (概念上為 100 點, 每次研究會填充進度).
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType_tooltip.cn:
改良 (研究) 新疫苗等级时的结果判定类型.
-累进几率 - 失败时, 下一次的成功几率会提升 (可累积);
-固定几率 - 固定的成功百分比 (第二至第四级分别为 30, 20, 14%%);
-完整研究 - 存在一条隐藏的研究进度条 (概念上为 100 点, 每次研究会填充进度).

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours_tooltip.cn: 放在地上且远离任何蜂箱的糖水罐或蜂蜜罐, 经过这么多小时后会变成野生酵母引子. 48 = 当前值 (两天). 0 = 永不. 位于蜂箱范围内的罐子会被蜜蜂喝掉, 永远不会发酸.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HoneycombYieldMultipl.en: Scales how many filled combs each production cycle adds. 1.0 = current (2-4), 2.0 = double. The hive still holds no more than its cells.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HoneycombYieldMultipl.ch: 調整每個生產週期新增多少滿載的蜂巢. 1.0 = 目前值 (2-4), 2.0 = 兩倍. 蜂箱能容納的數量仍以其巢房上限為準.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HoneycombYieldMultipl.cn: 调整每个生产周期新增多少满载的蜂巢. 1.0 = 当前值 (2-4), 2.0 = 两倍. 蜂箱能容纳的数量仍以其巢房上限为准.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadFermentationSpeed.en: Scales how fast mead barrels ferment through Young, Normal, Aged (and Spoiled). 1.0 = current pacing, 2.0 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed. Applies to batches already fermenting.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadFermentationSpeed.ch: 調整蜂蜜酒桶經過新釀, 正常, 熟成 (以及變質) 各階段的發酵速度. 1.0 = 目前節奏, 2.0 = 兩倍速, 0.5 = 半速. 對已在發酵的批次同樣生效.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadFermentationSpeed.cn: 调整蜂蜜酒桶经过新酿, 正常, 熟成 (以及变质) 各阶段的发酵速度. 1.0 = 当前节奏, 2.0 = 两倍速, 0.5 = 半速. 对已在发酵的批次同样生效.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.en: Bee and larvae growth per cycle
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.ch: 每週期蜜蜂與幼蟲成長量
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.cn: 每周期蜜蜂与幼虫成长量

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HibernationTemperatur.en: At or below this temperature the bees hibernate and the hive stops. 7 = current. Lower it for hardier bees, raise it for a shorter season.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HibernationTemperatur.ch: 溫度達到或低於此值時, 蜜蜂會進入冬眠, 蜂箱停止運作. 7 = 目前值. 調低代表蜜蜂更耐寒, 調高則產季更短.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HibernationTemperatur.cn: 温度达到或低于此值时, 蜜蜂会进入冬眠, 蜂箱停止运行. 7 = 当前值. 调低代表蜜蜂更耐寒, 调高则产季更短.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_BeeStingsEnabled_tool.en: When off, angry bees are still shown but never sting - no health damage, poison or swelling. For relaxed servers.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_BeeStingsEnabled_tool.ch: 關閉時, 憤怒的蜜蜂仍會出現, 但永遠不會螫人 - 不造成生命損傷, 中毒或腫脹. 適合輕鬆向的伺服器.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_BeeStingsEnabled_tool.cn: 关闭时, 愤怒的蜜蜂仍会出现, 但永远不会蜇人 - 不造成生命损伤, 中毒或肿胀. 适合轻松向的服务器.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_RoyalJellyHours_toolt.en: How long a full, queenless hive takes to make royal jelly. 72 = current (three days).
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_RoyalJellyHours_toolt.ch: 一個滿載且沒有蜂后的蜂箱需要多久才能產出蜂王乳. 72 = 目前值 (三天).
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_RoyalJellyHours_toolt.cn: 一个满载且没有蜂后的蜂箱需要多久才能产出蜂王浆. 72 = 当前值 (三天).

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.en: How many working hours one litre of stored sugar water buys. 24 = a full day of work per litre. The bees only drink while they are actually working, so a hive halted by rain or frost loses nothing from its supply. A hive holding any sugar water forages as if there were an ordinary spread of flowers around it - enough to keep working through winter or a poor biome, but no better than a decent summer.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.ch: 蜂箱儲存的一公升糖水能換得多少工作時數. 24 = 每公升可支撐整整一天的工作. 蜜蜂只在實際工作時才會飲用, 因此因下雨或結霜而停擺的蜂箱不會消耗存量. 只要蜂箱裡還有糖水, 採集效果就等同周圍有一般水準的花叢 - 足以撐過冬季或貧瘠的生態環境, 但也不會優於條件不錯的夏季.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.cn: 蜂箱储存的一升糖水能换得多少工作时长. 24 = 每升可支撑整整一天的工作. 蜜蜂只在实际工作时才会饮用, 因此因下雨或结霜而停摆的蜂箱不会消耗存量. 只要蜂箱里还有糖水, 采集效果就等同周围有一般水准的花丛 - 足以撑过冬季或贫瘠的生态环境, 但也不会优于条件不错的夏季.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.en: Scales how long a bee smoker keeps a hive calm. 1.0 = current, 2.0 = smoke lasts twice as long.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.ch: 調整蜂箱燻煙器讓蜂箱保持鎮定的時間. 1.0 = 目前值, 2.0 = 煙霧效果持續兩倍長.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.cn: 调整蜂箱熏烟器让蜂箱保持镇定的时间. 1.0 = 当前值, 2.0 = 烟雾效果持续两倍长.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.en: Scales how many bees and larvae each production cycle adds. 1.0 = current, 2.0 = double. Kept separate from honeycomb so honey and colony can be tuned apart.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.ch: 調整每個生產週期新增多少蜜蜂與幼蟲. 1.0 = 目前值, 2.0 = 兩倍. 與蜂巢產量分開設定, 讓蜂蜜與蜂群可以各自調整.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.cn: 调整每个生产周期新增多少蜜蜂与幼虫. 1.0 = 当前值, 2.0 = 两倍. 与蜂巢产量分开设置, 让蜂蜜与蜂群可以各自调整.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.ch: 蜜蜂憤怒持續時間倍率
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.cn: 蜜蜂愤怒持续时间倍率

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedBoostMultipli.en: Extra production while a hive is fed, on top of the forage the sugar water stands in for. 1.15 = 15%% faster, 1.0 = no bonus at all (the forage rescue still applies). Rain, snow and freezing still stop the hive no matter how well fed it is.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedBoostMultipli.ch: 蜂箱獲得餵食時的額外產量, 疊加在糖水所替代的蜜源之上. 1.15 = 快 15%%, 1.0 = 完全沒有加成 (糖水替代蜜源的保底仍然生效). 不論餵得多飽, 下雨, 下雪與結凍依然會讓蜂箱停止運作.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedBoostMultipli.cn: 蜂箱获得喂食时的额外产量, 叠加在糖水所替代的蜜源之上. 1.15 = 快 15%%, 1.0 = 完全没有加成 (糖水替代蜜源的保底仍然生效). 不论喂得多饱, 下雨, 下雪与结冻依然会让蜂箱停止运行.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.en: Sugar water: working hours per litre
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.ch: 糖水: 每公升可支撐的工作時數
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.cn: 糖水: 每升可支撑的工作时长

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadSpoilageEnabled_t.en: When disabled, a batch left too long holds at Aged quality forever instead of turning Spoiled.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadSpoilageEnabled_t.ch: 停用時, 放置過久的批次會永遠停留在熟成品質, 而不會變質.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadSpoilageEnabled_t.cn: 禁用时, 放置过久的批次会永远停留在熟成品质, 而不会变质.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.en: Scales how long bees stay angry after you disturb or crack open hives and nests. 1.0 = current, 0 = they calm down almost immediately, 2.0 = twice as long.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.ch: 調整你擾動或敲開蜂巢與蜂窩後, 蜜蜂持續憤怒的時間. 1.0 = 目前值, 0 = 幾乎立刻平息, 2.0 = 兩倍長.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.cn: 调整你扰动或敲开蜂巢与蜂窝后, 蜜蜂持续愤怒的时间. 1.0 = 当前值, 0 = 几乎立刻平息, 2.0 = 两倍长.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.ch: 燻煙鎮定持續時間倍率
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.cn: 熏烟镇定持续时间倍率

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours.en: Jars left out sour into yeast after (hours)
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours.ch: 罐子放置多久後發酸成酵母 (小時)
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours.cn: 罐子放置多久后发酸成酵母 (小时)

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLarvaeRaiseHours.en: How long placed queen larvae take to become a new queen. 48 = current (two days).
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLarvaeRaiseHours.ch: 放入的蜂后幼蟲需要多久才會長成新蜂后. 48 = 目前值 (兩天).
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLarvaeRaiseHours.cn: 放入的蜂后幼虫需要多久才会长成新蜂后. 48 = 当前值 (两天).

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_PropolisChance_toolti.en: Chance a harvest that collects honeycomb also yields propolis. 0.30 = current (30%%), 0 = never, 1.0 = always.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_PropolisChance_toolti.ch: 採收蜂巢時同時獲得蜂膠的機率. 0.30 = 目前值 (30%%), 0 = 永不, 1.0 = 必定獲得.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_PropolisChance_toolti.cn: 采收蜂巢时同时获得蜂胶的概率. 0.30 = 当前值 (30%%), 0 = 永不, 1.0 = 必定获得.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenForageWeightMult.en: Scales how often Queen Bees appear while foraging, in every zone. 1.0 = default scarcity (roughly one queen per 2-5 in-game hours of daytime foraging in forest zones, in season Apr-Oct, none Dec-Mar). 2.0 = about twice as common. 0 = queens never appear from foraging.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenForageWeightMult.ch: 調整所有區域中採集時遇到蜂后的頻率. 1.0 = 預設稀有度 (在森林區域白天採集, 產季 4 至 10 月時, 大約每 2-5 個遊戲小時出現一隻蜂后, 12 至 3 月完全不會出現). 2.0 = 約兩倍常見. 0 = 採集永遠不會找到蜂后.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenForageWeightMult.cn: 调整所有区域中采集时遇到蜂后的频率. 1.0 = 默认稀有度 (在森林区域白天采集, 产季 4 至 10 月时, 大约每 2-5 个游戏小时出现一只蜂后, 12 至 3 月完全不会出现). 2.0 = 约两倍常见. 0 = 采集永远不会找到蜂后.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveProductionSpeedMu.en: How fast a working hive fills its comb and grows. 1.0 = current pacing, 2.0 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed. Weather, temperature, flowers and feeding still apply on top.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveProductionSpeedMu.ch: 運作中的蜂箱填滿蜂巢與成長的速度. 1.0 = 目前節奏, 2.0 = 兩倍速, 0.5 = 半速. 天氣, 溫度, 花叢與餵食的影響仍會疊加其上.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveProductionSpeedMu.cn: 运行中的蜂箱填满蜂巢与成长的速度. 1.0 = 当前节奏, 2.0 = 两倍速, 0.5 = 半速. 天气, 温度, 花丛与喂食的影响仍会叠加其上.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_PropolisChance.ch: 採收時獲得蜂膠的機率
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_PropolisChance.cn: 采收时获得蜂胶的概率

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLarvaeRaiseHours.ch: 蜂后幼蟲培育時間 (小時)
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLarvaeRaiseHours.cn: 蜂后幼虫培育时间 (小时)

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLifespanDays_too.en: How many days a queen lays before she needs replacing. 7 = current. Longer games may want 14-30. Applies to queens inserted or raised after the change.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLifespanDays_too.ch: 蜂后能產卵幾天後才需要更換. 7 = 目前值. 長期遊玩的存檔可考慮 14-30. 僅對修改後放入或培育出的蜂后生效.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLifespanDays_too.cn: 蜂后能产卵几天后才需要更换. 7 = 当前值. 长期游玩的存档可考虑 14-30. 仅对修改后放入或培育出的蜂后生效.

Sandbox_CustomizableRecipes_CContainersR.ch: 回收已安裝的升級套件
Sandbox_CustomizableRecipes_CContainersR.cn: 回收已安装的升级套件

Sandbox_CustomizableRecipes_CContainersR.en: Allows you to recover the installed upgrade kit when upgrading a container to a higher tier.
Sandbox_CustomizableRecipes_CContainersR.ch: 將容器升級至更高階時, 可回收原本已安裝的升級套件.
Sandbox_CustomizableRecipes_CContainersR.cn: 将容器升级至更高阶时, 可回收原本已安装的升级套件.

Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.en: Set an explicit capacity for supported container types.
Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.ch: 為支援的容器類型指定明確的容量值.
Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.cn: 为支持的容器类型指定明确的容量值.

Sandbox_CustomizableRecipes_CContainersA.en: When enabled, any available higher-tier kit can be applied directly without applying intermediate tiers. Upgrade kit recipes do not require previous-tier kits.
Sandbox_CustomizableRecipes_CContainersA.ch: 啟用後, 任何可用的更高階套件都能直接套用, 無需先套用中間階級. 升級套件配方不再需要前一階的套件.
Sandbox_CustomizableRecipes_CContainersA.cn: 启用后, 任何可用的更高阶套件都能直接应用, 无需先应用中间阶级. 升级套件配方不再需要前一阶的套件.

Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.en: Set an explicit weight reduction for supported container types.
Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.ch: 為支援的容器類型指定明確的減重效果數值.
Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.cn: 为支持的容器类型指定明确的减重效果数值.

Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.en: Set an explicit weight for supported container types.
Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.ch: 為支援的容器類型指定明確的重量值.
Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.cn: 为支持的容器类型指定明确的重量值.

Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.en: Configure blacklist and custom Capacity, Weight Reduction, and Weight overrides for supported containers.
Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.ch: 為支援的容器設定黑名單, 以及自訂的容量, 減重效果與重量覆寫值.
Sandbox_CustomizableContainers_Overrides.cn: 为支持的容器设置黑名单, 以及自定义的容量, 减重效果与重量覆盖值.

Sandbox_ETW_HomichlophobiaMultiplier_too.en: Determines how much Homichlophobia affects the player. The formula for stress and panic increase every minute you're in fog is: 4%% * fogIntensity * Homichlophobia Multiplier. Fog intensity ranges from 0 to 1, so the full 4%% increase is rare
Sandbox_ETW_HomichlophobiaMultiplier_too.ch: 決定恐霧症對玩家的影響程度. 你在霧中每分鐘增加壓力和恐慌的公式為: 4%% * 霧強度 * 恐霧症倍率. 霧強度範圍0到1, 所以完整的4%%增加很少見
Sandbox_ETW_HomichlophobiaMultiplier_too.cn: 决定恐雾症对玩家的影响程度. 你在雾中每分钟增加压力和恐慌的公式为: 4%% * 雾强度 * 恐雾症倍率. 雾强度范围0到1, 所以完整的4%%增加很少见

Sandbox_ETW_HomichlophileMultiplier_tool.en: Determines how much Homichlophile affects the player. The formula for stress and panic decrease every minute you're in fog is: 4%% * fogIntensity * Homichlophile Multiplier. Fog intensity ranges from 0 to 1, so the full 4%% decrease is rare
Sandbox_ETW_HomichlophileMultiplier_tool.ch: 決定喜霧者對玩家的影響程度. 你在霧中每分鐘減少壓力和恐慌的公式為: 4%% * 霧強度 * 喜霧者倍率. 霧強度範圍0到1, 所以完整的4%%減少很少見
Sandbox_ETW_HomichlophileMultiplier_tool.cn: 决定喜雾者对玩家的影响程度. 你在雾中每分钟减少压力和恐慌的公式为: 4%% * 雾强度 * 喜雾者倍率. 雾强度范围0到1, 所以完整的4%%减少很少见

Sandbox_SaucedCarts_ProtectFromWorldClea.ch: 保護手推車不被世界清理刪除
Sandbox_SaucedCarts_ProtectFromWorldClea.cn: 保护手推车不被世界清理删除

Sandbox_SaucedCarts_ProtectFromWorldClea.en: Only matters on servers that run world cleanup in keep-list mode (ItemRemovalListBlacklistToggle enabled), where every item type not on the WorldItemRemovalList is deleted at chunk load — including carts left on the ground with all their cargo. When this option is enabled, SaucedCarts adds its cart types to that list in memory at every boot so cleanup can never delete a cart. Off by default because it changes how your cleanup list behaves; nothing is ever written to your config files.
Sandbox_SaucedCarts_ProtectFromWorldClea.ch: 僅在以保留清單模式執行世界清理的伺服器上才有意義 (啟用了 ItemRemovalListBlacklistToggle), 此時所有不在 WorldItemRemovalList 上的物品類型都會在區塊載入時被刪除 — 包含留在地上且裝著全部貨物的手推車. 啟用此選項後, SaucedCarts 會在每次啟動時於記憶體中把自己的手推車類型加入該清單, 讓清理永遠不會刪除手推車. 預設關閉, 因為它會改變你的清理清單行為; 但絕不會寫入你的設定檔.
Sandbox_SaucedCarts_ProtectFromWorldClea.cn: 仅在以保留列表模式运行世界清理的服务器上才有意义 (启用了 ItemRemovalListBlacklistToggle), 此时所有不在 WorldItemRemovalList 上的物品类型都会在区块加载时被删除 — 包含留在地上且装着全部货物的手推车. 启用此选项后, SaucedCarts 会在每次启动时于内存中把自己的手推车类型加入该列表, 让清理永远不会删除手推车. 默认关闭, 因为它会改变你的清理列表行为; 但绝不会写入你的配置文件.

Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_WeatherInflue.en:
Weather conditions affect the chance of outages.
Bad weather increases the chance of outages and decreases the chance of restoration.
Determines the maximum percentage of weather influence on the chance.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_WeatherInflue.ch:
天氣狀況會影響停水發生的機率.
惡劣天氣會提高中斷機率, 並降低供水恢復的機率.
決定天氣對機率影響的最大百分比.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_WeatherInflue.cn:
天气状况会影响停水发生的概率.
恶劣天气会提高中断概率, 并降低供水恢复的概率.
决定天气对概率影响的最大百分比.

Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_DynamicWaterC.en:
Dynamically adjusts the chance of shutoffs and restorations based on how close the scheduled shutoff day is.
Uses the maximum chance set in the Shutoff Chance and Restore Chance settings.
The restore chance always remains at a minimum of 5%%.
It is recommended to use a cooldown when this option is enabled.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_DynamicWaterC.ch:
根據預定停水日的接近程度, 動態調整停水與供水恢復的機率.
使用'停水機率'與'供水恢復機率'設定中的最大機率值.
恢復機率始終維持在至少 5%%.
啟用此選項時建議搭配冷卻時間.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_DynamicWaterC.cn:
根据预定停水日的接近程度, 动态调整停水与供水恢复的概率.
使用'停水概率'与'供水恢复概率'设置中的最大概率值.
恢复概率始终维持在至少 5%%.
启用此选项时建议搭配冷却时间.

Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_DynamicElectr.en:
Dynamically adjusts the chance of shutoffs and restorations based on how close the scheduled shutoff day is.
Uses the maximum chance set in the Shutoff Chance and Restore Chance settings.
The restore chance always remains at a minimum of 5%%.
It is recommended to use a cooldown when this option is enabled.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_DynamicElectr.ch:
根據預定停電日的接近程度, 動態調整停電與電力恢復的機率.
使用'斷電機率'與'電力恢復機率'設定中的最大機率值.
恢復機率始終維持在至少 5%%.
啟用此選項時建議搭配冷卻時間.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_DynamicElectr.cn:
根据预定停电日的接近程度, 动态调整停电与电力恢复的概率.
使用'断电概率'与'电力恢复概率'设置中的最大概率值.
恢复概率始终维持在至少 5%%.
启用此选项时建议搭配冷却时间.

Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_WeatherInflue.en:
Weather conditions affect the chance of outages.
Bad weather increases the chance of outages and decreases the chance of restoration.
Determines the maximum percentage of weather influence on the chance.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_WeatherInflue.ch:
天氣狀況會影響停電發生的機率.
惡劣天氣會提高中斷機率, 並降低電力恢復的機率.
決定天氣對機率影響的最大百分比.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_WeatherInflue.cn:
天气状况会影响停电发生的概率.
恶劣天气会提高中断概率, 并降低电力恢复的概率.
决定天气对概率影响的最大百分比.

Sandbox_LCO_StartWithLCGrey_tooltip.en: Start with a Legendary Cap (Grey) in your inventory.
Sandbox_LCO_StartWithLCGrey_tooltip.ch: 開局時物品欄中就帶有一頂傳奇棒球帽 (灰色).
Sandbox_LCO_StartWithLCGrey_tooltip.cn: 开局时物品栏中就带有一顶传奇棒球帽 (灰色).

Sandbox_LCO_StartWithLCFlashlight_toolti.en: Start with a Legendary Flashlight in your inventory.
Sandbox_LCO_StartWithLCFlashlight_toolti.ch: 開局時物品欄中就帶有一支傳奇手電筒.
Sandbox_LCO_StartWithLCFlashlight_toolti.cn: 开局时物品栏中就带有一支传奇手电筒.

Sandbox_SkillRecoveryJournalIlliterateSp.en: Set to 0 to prevent illiterate people from reading.
Sandbox_SkillRecoveryJournalIlliterateSp.ch: 設為 0 可讓文盲無法閱讀.
Sandbox_SkillRecoveryJournalIlliterateSp.cn: 设为 0 可让文盲无法阅读.

Sandbox_ammomaker_CollectAdditionalSeeds.en: Adds additional seeds to the player inventory when using the collect seeds recipe from the base game
Sandbox_ammomaker_CollectAdditionalSeeds.ch: 使用本體收集種子配方時, 額外把種子加入玩家物品欄
Sandbox_ammomaker_CollectAdditionalSeeds.cn: 使用本体收集种子配方时, 额外把种子加入玩家物品栏

Sandbox_ammomaker_DropCasingsReload_tool.en: Drops casings on ground when reloading revolvers or break-action firearms instead of adding them to player inventory
Sandbox_ammomaker_DropCasingsReload_tool.ch: 為左輪或中折式槍械裝彈時把彈殼掉在地上, 而不是放進玩家物品欄
Sandbox_ammomaker_DropCasingsReload_tool.cn: 为左轮或中折式枪械装弹时把弹壳掉在地上, 而不是放进玩家物品栏

Sandbox_ammomaker_ShowHiddenRecipes_tool.en: Shows inactive recipes as N/A in the crafting menu
Sandbox_ammomaker_ShowHiddenRecipes_tool.ch: 在製作選單把未啟用的配方顯示為N/A
Sandbox_ammomaker_ShowHiddenRecipes_tool.cn: 在制作菜单把未启用的配方显示为N/A

Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemSleepingMultipli.en: Multiplies Healer System counter changes while the player is asleep. The default greatly reduces changes caused by wounds that cannot be tended during sleep.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemSleepingMultipli.ch: 玩家睡著時, 治療系統計數的變化倍率. 預設會大幅降低睡眠中無法包紮的傷口所造成的變化.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemSleepingMultipli.cn: 玩家睡着时, 治疗系统计数的变化倍率. 默认会大幅降低睡眠中无法包扎的伤口所造成的变化.

Sandbox_ETW_PainToleranceExerciseMultipl.en: Multiplies only the exercise-stiffness portion of pain added to the Pain Tolerance counter. Pain from wounds and other sources is unaffected.
Sandbox_ETW_PainToleranceExerciseMultipl.ch: 此倍率只套用在疼痛耐受計數中來自運動僵硬的那一部分. 傷口或其他來源造成的疼痛不受影響.
Sandbox_ETW_PainToleranceExerciseMultipl.cn: 此倍率仅适用于疼痛耐受计数中来自运动僵硬的部分. 伤口或其他来源造成的疼痛不受影响.

Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_PauseWhileDriv.en: Skips global event scans while all active players travel in vehicles and stops this mod's heat, rain-exposure and forced wind-sprite updates for the driver. Active weather is kept; it is never cleared.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_PauseWhileDriv.ch: 所有線上玩家都在載具裡時略過全域事件掃描, 並停止本模組對駕駛者的高溫、淋雨與強制風效更新. 進行中的天氣會保留, 絕不會被清除.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_PauseWhileDriv.cn: 所有在线玩家都在载具内时跳过全局事件扫描, 并停止本模组针对驾驶者的高温、淋雨与强制风效更新. 进行中的天气会保留, 绝不会被清除.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_PauseWhileDriv._note: 2026-08-21 CN 逐鍵在地化：跳过／全局／载具内；wind-sprite 譯為「風效」避免誤讀為奇幻精靈。

Sandbox_WorkingKnowledge_ConsumeOnRead_t.en: When enabled, a document is destroyed once it has been read, so it cannot be passed to another survivor. Intended for multiplayer servers that do not want a single copy training the whole group. Default: off.
Sandbox_WorkingKnowledge_ConsumeOnRead_t.ch: 啟用後, 文件一經閱讀就會銷毀, 無法再傳給其他倖存者. 給不想讓一份副本訓練整隊的多人伺服器使用. 預設: 關.
Sandbox_WorkingKnowledge_ConsumeOnRead_t.cn: 启用后, 文件一经阅读就会销毁, 无法再传给其他幸存者. 给不想让一份副本训练整队的多人服务器使用. 默认: 关.

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_AimingXPMultipli.en: Multiplies the base Aiming XP awarded when attacking or killing zombies with bows and crossbows. (Default: 1.0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_AimingXPMultipli.ch: 用弓或弩攻擊或擊殺殭屍時, 基礎瞄準經驗的倍率. (預設: 1.0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_AimingXPMultipli.cn: 用弓或弩攻击或击杀僵尸时, 基础瞄准经验的倍率. (默认: 1.0)

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_DamageScale_tool.en: A global multiplier applied to the base damage of all bows and crossbows. Increase this if you want bows to be more lethal. (Default: 1.0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_DamageScale_tool.ch: 套用到所有弓和弩基礎傷害的全域倍率. 想讓弓更致命就調高. (預設: 1.0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_DamageScale_tool.cn: 应用到所有弓和弩基础伤害的全局倍率. 想让弓更致命就调高. (默认: 1.0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_DamageScale_tool._note: ｜2026-08-21 CN 詞級在地化修正。 ｜2026-08-21 對齊本包既有慣例：CN 应用/示例/粘性、CH 反坦克。

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_RecoverMissedArr.en: The % chance (0-100) that a missed arrow or bolt survives hitting walls or the ground, allowing you to pick it back up. (Default: 100)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_RecoverMissedArr.ch: 射失的箭或弩矢打到牆或地面後仍能留下來讓你撿回的機率%% (0-100). (預設: 100)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_RecoverMissedArr.cn: 射失的箭或弩矢打到墙或地面后仍能留下来让你捡回的几率%% (0-100). (默认: 100)

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_RetroactiveSpawn.en: If checked, the server will automatically scan empty hunting and gun containers as you explore the world, spawning bows in them. Turn this on if you added this mod to an existing save!
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_RetroactiveSpawn.ch: 勾選後, 伺服器會在你探索世界時自動掃描空的狩獵與槍械容器並在裡面生成弓. 若是把本模組加進既有存檔, 請開啟這個選項!
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_RetroactiveSpawn.cn: 勾选后, 服务器会在你探索世界时自动扫描空的狩猎与枪械容器并在里面生成弓. 若是把本模组加进既有存档, 请开启这个选项!

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_SpawnRateMultipl.en: Multiplies the chance of finding bows, crossbows, and ammo in the world. Set higher than 1.0 to find them more often. (Default: 1.0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_SpawnRateMultipl.ch: 在世界上找到弓、弩和彈藥的機率倍率. 設高於 1.0 會更容易找到. (預設: 1.0)
Sandbox_SVRPClassicBows_SpawnRateMultipl.cn: 在世界上找到弓、弩和弹药的几率倍率. 设高于 1.0 会更容易找到. (默认: 1.0)

Sandbox_ISIL_CaliberBasedWear.ch: 依口徑消耗消音器耐久
Sandbox_ISIL_CaliberBasedWear.cn: 依口径消耗消音器耐久

Sandbox_ISIL_CaliberBasedWear_tooltip.en: Adjusts suppressor wear by ammunition caliber. Small calibers consume less durability, while rifle and shotgun ammunition consume more. Unknown ammunition uses the standard 9mm wear rate.
Sandbox_ISIL_CaliberBasedWear_tooltip.ch: 依彈藥口徑調整消音器損耗. 小口徑消耗較少耐久, 步槍與霰彈則消耗較多. 未知彈藥套用標準 9mm 損耗率.
Sandbox_ISIL_CaliberBasedWear_tooltip.cn: 依弹药口径调整消音器损耗. 小口径消耗较少耐久, 步枪与霰弹则消耗较多. 未知弹药应用标准 9mm 损耗率.
Sandbox_ISIL_CaliberBasedWear_tooltip._note: ｜2026-08-21 對齊本包既有慣例：CN 应用/示例/粘性、CH 反坦克。

Sandbox_ISIL_EnableDurability_tooltip.en: Suppressors lose durability whenever the weapon is fired and are destroyed when exhausted. Only applies while Extended Realism Mode is enabled.
Sandbox_ISIL_EnableDurability_tooltip.ch: 每次開槍消音器都會掉耐久, 耗盡即毀. 只在啟用進階寫實模式時生效.
Sandbox_ISIL_EnableDurability_tooltip.cn: 每次开枪消音器都会掉耐久, 耗尽即毁. 只在启用进阶写实模式时生效.

Sandbox_ISIL_ExtendedMode_tooltip.en: Enables configurable suppression strength and optional suppressor durability. Disabled by default to preserve the original mod balance.
Sandbox_ISIL_ExtendedMode_tooltip.ch: 啟用可設定的消音強度與可選的消音器耐久. 預設關閉以保留模組原本的平衡.
Sandbox_ISIL_ExtendedMode_tooltip.cn: 启用可设定的消音强度与可选的消音器耐久. 默认关闭以保留模组原本的平衡.

Sandbox_ISIL_HandTorchDurability.ch: 手電筒消音器耐久 (基礎發數)
Sandbox_ISIL_HandTorchDurability.cn: 手电筒消音器耐久 (基础发数)

Sandbox_ISIL_HandTorchDurability_tooltip.ch: 手電筒消音器在毀掉前可承受的 9mm 等值射擊發數.
Sandbox_ISIL_HandTorchDurability_tooltip.cn: 手电筒消音器在毁掉前可承受的 9mm 等值射击发数.

Sandbox_ISIL_MetalPipeDurability.cn: 铁管消音器耐久 (基础发数)

Sandbox_ISIL_ProfessionalDurability.cn: 专业消音器耐久 (基础发数)

Sandbox_ISIL_ProfessionalDurability_tool.en: Number of 9mm-equivalent shots before a professional suppressor is destroyed.
Sandbox_ISIL_ProfessionalDurability_tool.ch: 專業消音器在毀掉前可承受的 9mm 等值射擊發數.
Sandbox_ISIL_ProfessionalDurability_tool.cn: 专业消音器在毁掉前可承受的 9mm 等值射击发数.

Sandbox_ISIL_WaterBottleDurability.cn: 水瓶消音器耐久 (基础发数)

Sandbox_ISIL_WaterBottleDurability_toolt.en: Number of 9mm-equivalent shots before a water bottle suppressor is destroyed.
Sandbox_ISIL_WaterBottleDurability_toolt.ch: 水瓶消音器在毀掉前可承受的 9mm 等值射擊發數.
Sandbox_ISIL_WaterBottleDurability_toolt.cn: 水瓶消音器在毁掉前可承受的 9mm 等值射击发数.

Sandbox_ISIL_WaterBottleNoiseReduction_t._note: ｜2026-08-21 對齊本包既有慣例：CN 应用/示例/粘性、CH 反坦克。

Sandbox_ETWTS_DisableAllCustomTraits_too.en: When enabled, all custom traits will be disabled for character creation and gameplay progression. This setting overrides all other trait-specific settings below.
Sandbox_ETWTS_DisableAllCustomTraits_too.ch: 啟用時, 所有自訂特質在角色建立與遊戲進程中都會被停用. 此設定會覆寫下方所有針對個別特質的設定.
Sandbox_ETWTS_DisableAllCustomTraits_too.cn: 启用时, 所有自定义特质在角色创建与游戏进程中都会被禁用. 此设置会覆盖下方所有针对单个特质的设置.

Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableReloadUnlo.en: Add a slice to reload/unload all magazines.
Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableReloadUnlo.ch: 新增裝填/清空所有彈匣的選項.
Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableReloadUnlo.cn: 添加装填/清空所有弹匣的选项.

Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableReloadUnlo.en: Add a slice in the weapon submenu to queue reloading/unloading all magazines.
Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableReloadUnlo.ch: 在武器子選單新增一個選項, 用於排入裝填/清空所有彈匣的動作.
Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableReloadUnlo.cn: 在武器子菜单添加一个选项, 用于排入装填/清空所有弹匣的动作.

Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableRipAllClot.en: Add a slice to rip all clothing.
Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableRipAllClot.ch: 新增撕開所有衣服的選項.
Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableRipAllClot.cn: 添加撕开所有衣服的选项.

Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableRipAllClot.en: Add a slice in the crafting submenu to queue ripping all clothing.
Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableRipAllClot.ch: 在合成子選單新增一個選項, 用於排入撕開所有衣服的動作.
Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableRipAllClot.cn: 在合成子菜单添加一个选项, 用于排入撕开所有衣服的动作.

Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableWringOutAl.en: Add a slice to wring out all wet clothes.
Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableWringOutAl.ch: 新增擰乾所有濕衣服的選項.
Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableWringOutAl.cn: 添加拧干所有湿衣服的选项.

Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableWringOutAl.en: Add a slice in the clothing item submenu to queue wringing out all wet clothes.
Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableWringOutAl.ch: 在衣物子選單新增一個選項, 用於排入擰乾所有濕衣服的動作.
Sandbox_SmartRadialMenu_EnableWringOutAl.cn: 在衣物子菜单添加一个选项, 用于排入拧干所有湿衣服的动作.

Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_EnableCraftingAdd.en: When disabled, hides and blocks the crafting recipes added by Break Big Rocks, prevents its vanilla forge-recipe patches, and stops automatic Blacksmithing recipe unlocks. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_EnableCraftingAdd.ch: 停用時, 會隱藏並封鎖 Break Big Rocks 新增的合成配方, 不套用其對原版鍛造爐配方的修改, 也不再自動解鎖鍛造配方. 預設啟用.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_EnableCraftingAdd.cn: 禁用时, 会隐藏并屏蔽 Break Big Rocks 添加的合成配方, 不应用其对原版锻造炉配方的修改, 也不再自动解锁锻造配方. 默认启用.

Sandbox_rSemiTruck_ContainerSpawns_toolt.en: If enabled, Containers can spawn in both normal and fixed vehicle zones. If disabled, Containers will not spawn.
Sandbox_rSemiTruck_ContainerSpawns_toolt.ch: 若啟用, 貨櫃可在一般車輛區域與固定車輛區域生成. 若停用, 貨櫃不會生成.
Sandbox_rSemiTruck_ContainerSpawns_toolt.cn: 若启用, 集装箱可以在常规和固定车辆区域生成. 若禁用, 集装箱将不会生成.

Sandbox_rSemiTruck_ContainerTrailerSpawn.en: If enabled, Container Trailers can spawn in both normal and fixed vehicle zones. If disabled, Container Trailers will not spawn.
Sandbox_rSemiTruck_ContainerTrailerSpawn.ch: 若啟用, 貨櫃拖車可在一般車輛區域與固定車輛區域生成. 若停用, 貨櫃拖車不會生成.
Sandbox_rSemiTruck_ContainerTrailerSpawn.cn: 若启用, 集装箱拖车可以在常规和固定车辆区域生成. 若禁用, 集装箱拖车将不会生成.

Sandbox_ConditionalSpeechAllowClientModO.en: Allow Clients To Edit Mod Options
Sandbox_ConditionalSpeechAllowClientModO.ch: 允許客戶端修改模組選項

Tooltip_Barrel.cn: 枪管. 枪管越长, 伤害越高, 射程越远, 抑制后坐力的效果也越好. 缺点是瞄准耗时更久, 因此不适合近距离作战. 枪械运行必需品.

Tooltip_BarrelSawed.en: A sawed off- A legally FFA modified gun barrel. A longer barrel gives you more damage, longer range, and a reduces recoil more. The downside is it takes longer to get on target, so it's not idea of close quarters. Required for the gun to fire.
Tooltip_BarrelSawed.ch: 鋸短型 - 經FFA合法改造的槍管. 槍管越長, 傷害越高, 射程越遠, 抑制後坐力的效果也越好. 缺點是瞄準耗時更久, 因此不適合近距離作戰. 槍械運作必需品.
Tooltip_BarrelSawed.cn: 锯短型 - 经FFA合法改造的枪管. 枪管越长, 伤害越高, 射程越远, 抑制后坐力的效果也越好. 缺点是瞄准耗时更久, 因此不适合近距离作战. 枪械运行必需品.

Tooltip_BarrelWithSights.en: A gun barrel, including the front sights. A longer barrel gives you more damage, greater sight range, longer range, and a reduces recoil more. The downside is it takes longer to get on target, so it's not idea of close quarters. Required for the gun to fire.
Tooltip_BarrelWithSights.ch: 附準星的槍管. 槍管越長, 傷害越高, 瞄準距離越遠, 射程越遠, 抑制後坐力的效果也越好. 缺點是瞄準耗時更久, 因此不適合近距離作戰. 槍械運作必需品.
Tooltip_BarrelWithSights.cn: 附准星的枪管. 枪管越长, 伤害越高, 瞄准距离越远, 射程越远, 抑制后坐力的效果也越好. 缺点是瞄准耗时更久, 因此不适合近距离作战. 枪械运行必需品.

Tooltip_Compensator45.en: Reduces weapon recoil. Fits most .45 caliber handguns.
Tooltip_Compensator45.ch: 降低武器後坐力. 適用於大多數 .45 口徑手槍.
Tooltip_Compensator45.cn: 降低武器后坐力. 适用于大多数 .45 口径手枪.

Tooltip_Compensator9mm.en: Reduces weapon recoil. Fits most 9mm handguns.
Tooltip_Compensator9mm.ch: 降低武器後坐力. 適用於大多數 9mm 手槍.
Tooltip_Compensator9mm.cn: 降低武器后坐力. 适用于大多数 9mm 手枪.

Tooltip_CompensatorAuto9.en: A custom compensator for the Beretta M9. Think you could outsmart a bullet?
Tooltip_CompensatorAuto9.ch: 貝瑞塔M9的客製補償器. 你以為你能比子彈更聰明嗎?
Tooltip_CompensatorAuto9.cn: 贝雷塔M9的定制补偿器. 你以为你能比子弹更聪明吗?

Tooltip_CylinderFull.en: A revolver cylinder, required for the gun to fire.
Tooltip_CylinderFull.ch: 左輪彈巢, 槍械運作必需品.
Tooltip_CylinderFull.cn: 左轮弹巢, 枪械运行必需品.

Tooltip_CylinderShort.en: A revolver cylinder, with a shortened extractor rod to fit very compact barrels. Required for the gun to fire.
Tooltip_CylinderShort.ch: 左輪彈巢, 退殼桿經過縮短以搭配極短的槍管. 槍械運作必需品.
Tooltip_CylinderShort.cn: 左轮弹巢, 退壳杆经过缩短以搭配极短的枪管. 枪械运行必需品.

Tooltip_Error.en: You shouldn't be seeing this, oops!
Tooltip_Error.ch: 你不該看到這個, 糟糕!
Tooltip_Error.cn: 你不该看到这个, 糟糕!

Tooltip_ExtendedTube.en: An extension for a tube magazine.

Tooltip_Foregrip93R.en: A front mounted grip for the Beretta 93R to help control recoil. You can fold it up when not in use to take up less space.
Tooltip_Foregrip93R.ch: 貝瑞塔93R的前握把, 有助於控制後坐力. 不用時可以摺起, 減少佔用空間.
Tooltip_Foregrip93R.cn: 贝雷塔93R的前握把, 有助于控制后坐力. 不用时可以折起, 减少占用空间.

Tooltip_ForendGeneric.en: Protective furniture that covers the barrel. You can shoot without it, but it's not recommended!
Tooltip_ForendGeneric.ch: 覆蓋槍管的防護護木. 沒有它也能射擊, 但不建議這麼做!
Tooltip_ForendGeneric.cn: 覆盖枪管的防护护木. 没有它也能射击, 但不建议这么做!

Tooltip_ForendPump.en: A forend that lets you to rack the gun. You can slowly shoot without it, but it's not recommended!
Tooltip_ForendPump.ch: 可用來為槍械上膛的護木. 沒有它也能射擊, 但速度很慢, 不建議這麼做!
Tooltip_ForendPump.cn: 可用来为枪械上膛的护木. 没有它也能射击, 但速度很慢, 不建议这么做!

Tooltip_ForendPumpFlashlight.en: A forend that lets you to rack the gun and has an integrated flashlight, for when you need some light on the subject.
Tooltip_ForendPumpFlashlight.ch: 可用來為槍械上膛的護木, 並整合手電筒, 讓你在需要時照亮目標.
Tooltip_ForendPumpFlashlight.cn: 可用来为枪械上膛的护木, 并整合手电筒, 让你在需要时照亮目标.

Tooltip_ForendRifleFlashlight.en: A forend that has an integrated flashlight, for when you need some light on the subject.
Tooltip_ForendRifleFlashlight.ch: 整合手電筒的護木, 讓你在需要時照亮目標.
Tooltip_ForendRifleFlashlight.cn: 整合手电筒的护木, 让你在需要时照亮目标.

Tooltip_HeavyBarrel.en: A heavy gun barrel. A longer barrel gives you more damage, longer range, and a reduces recoil more. The thicker barrel reduces it further. The downside is it takes longer to get on target, so it's not idea of close quarters. Required for the gun to fire.
Tooltip_HeavyBarrel.ch: 重型槍管. 槍管越長, 傷害越高, 射程越遠, 抑制後坐力的效果也越好. 加粗的管壁還能進一步降低後坐力. 缺點是瞄準耗時更久, 因此不適合近距離作戰. 槍械運作必需品.
Tooltip_HeavyBarrel.cn: 重型枪管. 枪管越长, 伤害越高, 射程越远, 抑制后坐力的效果也越好. 加粗的管壁还能进一步降低后坐力. 缺点是瞄准耗时更久, 因此不适合近距离作战. 枪械运行必需品.

Tooltip_HeavyBarrelSawed.en: A heavy sawed off- A legally FFA modified gun barrel. A longer barrel gives you more damage, longer range, and a reduces recoil more. The thicker barrel reduces it further. The downside is it takes longer to get on target, so it's not idea of close quarters. Required for the gun to fire.
Tooltip_HeavyBarrelSawed.ch: 鋸短型重型槍管 - 經FFA合法改造. 槍管越長, 傷害越高, 射程越遠, 抑制後坐力的效果也越好. 加粗的管壁還能進一步降低後坐力. 缺點是瞄準耗時更久, 因此不適合近距離作戰. 槍械運作必需品.
Tooltip_HeavyBarrelSawed.cn: 锯短型重型枪管 - 经FFA合法改造. 枪管越长, 伤害越高, 射程越远, 抑制后坐力的效果也越好. 加粗的管壁还能进一步降低后坐力. 缺点是瞄准耗时更久, 因此不适合近距离作战. 枪械运行必需品.

Tooltip_HeavyBarrelWithSights.en: A heavy gun barrel, including the front sights. A longer barrel gives you more damage, greater sight range, longer range, and a reduces recoil more. The thicker barrel reduces it further. The downside is it takes longer to get on target, so it's not idea of close quarters. Required for the gun to fire.
Tooltip_HeavyBarrelWithSights.ch: 附準星的重型槍管. 槍管越長, 傷害越高, 瞄準距離越遠, 射程越遠, 抑制後坐力的效果也越好. 加粗的管壁還能進一步降低後坐力. 缺點是瞄準耗時更久, 因此不適合近距離作戰. 槍械運作必需品.
Tooltip_HeavyBarrelWithSights.cn: 附准星的重型枪管. 枪管越长, 伤害越高, 瞄准距离越远, 射程越远, 抑制后坐力的效果也越好. 加粗的管壁还能进一步降低后坐力. 缺点是瞄准耗时更久, 因此不适合近距离作战. 枪械运行必需品.

Tooltip_LaserLs45.en: A weaver mounted laser sight. Only weighs one pound, just needs two 9v batteries, and lasts an unprecidented 10 minutes! Cutting edge technology!
Tooltip_LaserLs45.ch: 韋弗導軌式雷射瞄準器. 僅重一磅, 只需兩顆9V電池, 續航更是前所未有的10分鐘! 尖端科技!
Tooltip_LaserLs45.cn: 韦弗导轨式激光瞄准器. 仅重一磅, 只需两颗9V电池, 续航更是前所未有的10分钟! 尖端科技!

Tooltip_LaserTerminator.en: A frame mounted LPC T-1000 laser sight. Get ready to terminate some targets!
Tooltip_LaserTerminator.ch: 框架式LPC T-1000雷射瞄準器. 準備終結一些目標吧!
Tooltip_LaserTerminator.cn: 框架式LPC T-1000激光瞄准器. 准备终结一些目标吧!

Tooltip_PistolGripAuto9.en: Custom grips for the Beretta M9. I'd buy that for a dollar!
Tooltip_PistolGripAuto9.ch: 貝瑞塔M9的客製握把. 這東西我願意花一塊錢買下!
Tooltip_PistolGripAuto9.cn: 贝雷塔M9的定制握把. 这东西我愿意花一块钱买下!

Tooltip_PistolGripCustom.en: Custom grips for a pistol, for that couch warrior look!
Tooltip_PistolGripCustom.ch: 手槍的客製握把, 打造沙發戰士的造型!
Tooltip_PistolGripCustom.cn: 手枪的定制握把, 打造沙发战士的造型!

Tooltip_PistolGripPolymer.en: Polymer grips for a pistol, for that modern look!
Tooltip_PistolGripPolymer.ch: 手槍的聚合物握把, 打造現代感造型!
Tooltip_PistolGripPolymer.cn: 手枪的聚合物握把, 打造现代感造型!

Tooltip_PistolGripWood.en: Wooden grips for a pistol, for that classic look!
Tooltip_PistolGripWood.ch: 手槍的木製握把, 打造經典造型!
Tooltip_PistolGripWood.cn: 手枪的木制握把, 打造经典造型!

Tooltip_PistolLight.en: A tactical flashlight that fits most semi-automatic pistols.
Tooltip_PistolLight.ch: 適用於大多數半自動手槍的戰術手電筒.
Tooltip_PistolLight.cn: 适用于大多数半自动手枪的战术手电筒.

Tooltip_RifleGripCustom.en: A custom grip, for that couch warrior look!
Tooltip_RifleGripCustom.ch: 客製握把, 打造沙發戰士的造型!
Tooltip_RifleGripCustom.cn: 定制握把, 打造沙发战士的造型!

Tooltip_RifleGripPolymer.en: A polymer grip, for that modern look!
Tooltip_RifleGripPolymer.ch: 聚合物握把, 打造現代感造型!
Tooltip_RifleGripPolymer.cn: 聚合物握把, 打造现代感造型!

Tooltip_RifleGripWood.en: A wooden grip, for that modern look!
Tooltip_RifleGripWood.ch: 木製握把, 打造現代感造型!
Tooltip_RifleGripWood.cn: 木制握把, 打造现代感造型!

Tooltip_Scope2x.en: A weaver mounted scope with 2x magnification.
Tooltip_Scope2x.ch: 韋弗導軌式瞄準鏡, 放大倍率2倍.
Tooltip_Scope2x.cn: 韦弗导轨式瞄准镜, 放大倍率2倍.

Tooltip_Scope4x.en: A weaver mounted scope with 4x magnification.
Tooltip_Scope4x.ch: 韋弗導軌式瞄準鏡, 放大倍率4倍.
Tooltip_Scope4x.cn: 韦弗导轨式瞄准镜, 放大倍率4倍.

Tooltip_Scope8x.en: A weaver mounted scope with 8x magnification.
Tooltip_Scope8x.ch: 韋弗導軌式瞄準鏡, 放大倍率8倍.
Tooltip_Scope8x.cn: 韦弗导轨式瞄准镜, 放大倍率8倍.

Tooltip_ScopeAimpoint5000.en: A weaver mounted red dot sight. Top of the line, and used by Special Forces!
Tooltip_ScopeAimpoint5000.ch: 韋弗導軌式紅點瞄準器. 頂級貨色, 特種部隊愛用!
Tooltip_ScopeAimpoint5000.cn: 韦弗导轨式红点瞄准器. 顶级货色, 特种部队爱用!

Tooltip_ShotgunHeatshield.en: A heatshield that fits most popular shotgun barrels. It makes it quicker to reload, since you don't need to worry about burns from a hot barrel.
Tooltip_ShotgunHeatshield.ch: 適用於大多數常見霰彈槍槍管的隔熱護罩. 不必擔心被高溫槍管燙傷, 因此裝填更快.
Tooltip_ShotgunHeatshield.cn: 适用于大多数常见霰弹枪枪管的隔热护罩. 不必担心被高温枪管烫伤, 因此装填更快.

Tooltip_SideSaddleAmmo.en: A side saddle that holds ammunition closer to the magazine, making it quicker to reload. Mounts on the side of the receiver.
Tooltip_SideSaddleAmmo.ch: 側掛彈藥架, 把彈藥放在更靠近彈倉的位置, 讓裝填更快. 安裝在機匣側面.
Tooltip_SideSaddleAmmo.cn: 侧挂弹药架, 把弹药放在更靠近弹仓的位置, 让装填更快. 安装在机匣侧面.

Tooltip_SightTarget.en: Target shooting sights. Makes it easier to hit more distant targets, takes longer to aim at closer range.
Tooltip_SightTarget.ch: 標靶射擊瞄具. 更容易命中較遠的目標, 但近距離瞄準耗時更久.
Tooltip_SightTarget.cn: 标靶射击瞄具. 更容易命中较远的目标, 但近距离瞄准耗时更久.

Tooltip_SightTargetAuto9.en: Custom sights for the Beretta M9. For when you really need to fire someone.
Tooltip_SightTargetAuto9.ch: 貝瑞塔M9的客製瞄具. 當你真的需要開除某人時就用它.
Tooltip_SightTargetAuto9.cn: 贝雷塔M9的定制瞄具. 当你真的需要开除某人时就用它.

Tooltip_SightWeaverCarryhandle.en: A carryhandle with intigrated sights. Mounts on weaver rails.
Tooltip_SightWeaverCarryhandle.ch: 整合瞄具的提把. 安裝在韋弗導軌上.
Tooltip_SightWeaverCarryhandle.cn: 整合瞄具的提把. 安装在韦弗导轨上.

Tooltip_SightWeaverIron.en: Custom iron sights that mount on weaver rails.
Tooltip_SightWeaverIron.ch: 安裝在韋弗導軌上的客製機械瞄具.
Tooltip_SightWeaverIron.cn: 安装在韦弗导轨上的定制机械瞄具.

Tooltip_StockGeneric.en: A more solid stock reduces recoil and the time to zero in on a target.
Tooltip_StockGeneric.ch: 更紮實的槍托可降低後坐力, 並縮短瞄準所需時間.
Tooltip_StockGeneric.cn: 更扎实的枪托可降低后坐力, 并缩短瞄准所需时间.

Tooltip_StockGenericFolding.en: A stock that can be folded or collapsed to reduce space, but increase recoil and the time to get on target.
Tooltip_StockGenericFolding.ch: 可摺疊或收合以節省空間的槍托, 但會增加後坐力和瞄準所需時間.
Tooltip_StockGenericFolding.cn: 可折叠或收合以节省空间的枪托, 但会增加后坐力和瞄准所需时间.

Tooltip_StockGenericSawed.en: A sawed off- A legally FFA modified weapon stock. Not as good as a folding stock, but in close quarters, it's better than a musket! Makes it difficult to get on target quickly.
Tooltip_StockGenericSawed.ch: 鋸短型 - 經FFA合法改造的槍托. 不如摺疊槍托, 但在近距離作戰中總比火槍好用! 會讓快速瞄準變得困難.
Tooltip_StockGenericSawed.cn: 锯短型 - 经FFA合法改造的枪托. 不如折叠枪托, 但在近距离作战中总比火枪好用! 会让快速瞄准变得困难.

Tooltip_StockPistol93R.en: An small stock designed for the Beretta 93R pistol. It folds when removed, saving space. Somehow, it fits on most handguns.
Tooltip_StockPistol93R.ch: 專為貝瑞塔93R手槍設計的小型槍托. 拆下後可摺疊, 節省空間. 不知怎地, 它還能裝在大多數手槍上.
Tooltip_StockPistol93R.cn: 专为贝雷塔93R手枪设计的小型枪托. 拆下后可折叠, 节省空间. 不知怎的, 它还能装在大多数手枪上.

Tooltip_StockPistolWW2.en: An old pistol stock from WW2, they often doubled as a holster. Somehow, it fits on most handguns.
Tooltip_StockPistolWW2.ch: 二戰時期的舊式手槍槍托, 通常兼作槍套. 不知怎地, 它還能裝在大多數手槍上.
Tooltip_StockPistolWW2.cn: 二战时期的旧式手枪枪托, 通常兼作枪套. 不知怎的, 它还能装在大多数手枪上.

Tooltip_Suppressor45.en: Reduces the decibles to JUST loud enough to cause hearing damage on repeated use. Fits most .45 caliber weapons with a threaded barrel.
Tooltip_Suppressor45.ch: 把分貝降到「剛好」足以在反覆使用後造成聽力損傷的程度. 適用於大多數具備螺紋槍管的 .45 口徑武器.
Tooltip_Suppressor45.cn: 把分贝降到“刚好”足以在反复使用后造成听力损伤的程度. 适用于大多数具备螺纹枪管的 .45 口径武器.

Tooltip_Suppressor556.en: Reduces the decibles to JUST loud enough to cause hearing damage on repeated use. Fits most 5.56mm and .223 caliber weapons with a threaded barrel.
Tooltip_Suppressor556.ch: 把分貝降到「剛好」足以在反覆使用後造成聽力損傷的程度. 適用於大多數具備螺紋槍管的 5.56mm 和 .223 口徑武器.
Tooltip_Suppressor556.cn: 把分贝降到“刚好”足以在反复使用后造成听力损伤的程度. 适用于大多数具备螺纹枪管的 5.56mm 和 .223 口径武器.

Tooltip_Suppressor9mm.en: Reduces the decibles to JUST loud enough to cause hearing damage on repeated use. Fits most 9mm weapons with a threaded barrel.
Tooltip_Suppressor9mm.ch: 把分貝降到「剛好」足以在反覆使用後造成聽力損傷的程度. 適用於大多數具備螺紋槍管的 9mm 武器.
Tooltip_Suppressor9mm.cn: 把分贝降到“刚好”足以在反复使用后造成听力损伤的程度. 适用于大多数具备螺纹枪管的 9mm 武器.

Tooltip_SuppressorAllen.en: A custom suppressor that reduces the decibles to JUST loud enough to cause hearing damage on repeated use. Fits the full length M16A2 and XM4 barrels.
Tooltip_SuppressorAllen.ch: 客製消音器, 把分貝降到「剛好」足以在反覆使用後造成聽力損傷的程度. 適用於全長型 M16A2 與 XM4 槍管.
Tooltip_SuppressorAllen.cn: 定制消音器, 把分贝降到“刚好”足以在反复使用后造成听力损伤的程度. 适用于全长型 M16A2 与 XM4 枪管.

Tooltip_TriggerGroupBolt.en: A bolt action trigger group. Consists of the trigger and bolt assembly. Required for the gun to fire.
Tooltip_TriggerGroupBolt.ch: 栓動式火控組. 由扳機和槍機組件構成. 槍械運作必需品.
Tooltip_TriggerGroupBolt.cn: 栓动式火控组. 由扳机和枪机组件构成. 枪械运行必需品.

Tooltip_TriggerGroupBreak.en: A break action trigger group. Consists of the trigger, hammer, sear, and some springs. Required for the gun to fire.
Tooltip_TriggerGroupBreak.ch: 中折式火控組. 由扳機, 擊錘, 阻鐵和一些彈簧構成. 槍械運作必需品.
Tooltip_TriggerGroupBreak.cn: 中折式火控组. 由扳机, 击锤, 阻铁和一些弹簧构成. 枪械运行必需品.

Tooltip_TriggerGroupModdedFull.en: A modified semi-auto trigger group converted to full-auto. Consists of the trigger, hammer, full auto sear, safety and some springs, some of them filed down! Make sure to file off the serial number to go with it! Required for the gun to fire.
Tooltip_TriggerGroupModdedFull.ch: 由半自動火控組改造成全自動的火控組. 由扳機, 擊錘, 全自動阻鐵, 保險和一些彈簧構成, 其中部分還被銼過! 記得把序號也一併銼掉! 槍械運作必需品.

Tooltip_CmpFlaskWithBloodCells.en: Active blood cells. Further research and purification required.
Tooltip_CmpFlaskWithBloodCells.ch: 活性血球. 需要進一步研究與純化.
Tooltip_CmpFlaskWithBloodCells.cn: 活性血细胞. 需要进一步研究与纯化.

Tooltip_CmpFlaskWithBloodPlasma.en: Used as a component for creating medications.

Tooltip_CmpFlaskWithLeukocytes.en: Basis for vaccines and source of antibodies.
Tooltip_CmpFlaskWithLeukocytes.ch: 疫苗的基礎, 也是抗體的來源.
Tooltip_CmpFlaskWithLeukocytes.cn: 疫苗的基础, 也是抗体的来源.

Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithBlood.en: Used for further analysis, research, and vaccine development.
Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithBlood.ch: 用於後續分析、研究與疫苗研發.
Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithBlood.cn: 用于后续分析、研究与疫苗研发.

Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithCure.en:
Vaccine in a reusable syringe.
Completely cures infection.
Grants one day of virus immunity if uninfected.
Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithCure.ch:
可複用注射器中的疫苗.
可完全治癒感染.
未感染時可獲得一天的病毒免疫.
Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithCure.cn:
可复用注射器中的疫苗.
可完全治愈感染.
未感染时可获得一天的病毒免疫.

Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithPlainVacci.en:
Vaccine in a reusable syringe.
Reduces infection to 5%.
Low reaction to albumin, ~5-7 pills.
Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithPlainVacci.ch:
可複用注射器中的疫苗.
可將感染度降至 5%%.
白蛋白反應低, 約需 5-7 顆.
Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithPlainVacci.cn:
可复用注射器中的疫苗.
可将感染度降至 5%%.
白蛋白反应低, 约需 5-7 颗.

Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithQualityVac.en:
Vaccine in a reusable syringe.
Reduces infection to 5%.
Grants one day of virus immunity if uninfected.
High reaction to albumin, ~9-12 pills.
Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithQualityVac.ch:
可複用注射器中的疫苗.
可將感染度降至 5%%.
未感染時可獲得一天的病毒免疫.
白蛋白反應高, 約需 9-12 顆.
Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithQualityVac.cn:
可复用注射器中的疫苗.
可将感染度降至 5%%.
未感染时可获得一天的病毒免疫.
白蛋白反应高, 约需 9-12 颗.

Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithSerum.en:
Vaccine in a reusable syringe.
Completely cures infection.
Grants two days of virus immunity if uninfected.
Gives a chance (cumulative) to obtain resistant antibodies if infected.
Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithSerum.ch:
可複用注射器中的疫苗.
可完全治癒感染.
未感染時可獲得兩天的病毒免疫.
已感染時有機率 (可累積) 取得抗性抗體.
Tooltip_CmpSyringeReusableWithSerum.cn:
可复用注射器中的疫苗.
可完全治愈感染.
未感染时可获得两天的病毒免疫.
已感染时有几率 (可累积) 获得抗性抗体.

Tooltip_CmpSyringeWithSerum.en:
Vaccine in a disposable syringe.
Completely cures infection.
Grants two days of virus immunity if uninfected.
Gives a chance (cumulative) to obtain resistant antibodies if infected.
Tooltip_CmpSyringeWithSerum.ch:
拋棄式注射器中的疫苗.
可完全治癒感染.
未感染時可獲得兩天的病毒免疫.
已感染時有機率 (可累積) 取得抗性抗體.
Tooltip_CmpSyringeWithSerum.cn:
一次性注射器中的疫苗.
可完全治愈感染.
未感染时可获得两天的病毒免疫.
已感染时有几率 (可累积) 获得抗性抗体.

Tooltip_CmpTestTubeWithAntibodies.en: Basis for creating a cure for the zombie virus.
Tooltip_CmpTestTubeWithAntibodies.ch: 製作殭屍病毒解藥的基礎.
Tooltip_CmpTestTubeWithAntibodies.cn: 制作僵尸病毒解药的基础.

Tooltip_CmpTestTubeWithInfectedBlood.en:
«V+» - zombie virus infection present, «V-» - none;
«A+» - resistant antibodies present, «A-» - none;
«V+[N]», where N - infection percentage!
When separating into components, bonus to obtaining blood cells:
- Type «V-, A-»: -20 percent;
- Type «V-, A+": +25 percent;
- Type «V+, A-»: +30 percent;
- Type «V+, A+»: +40 percent.
Tooltip_CmpTestTubeWithInfectedBlood.ch:
«V+» - 帶有殭屍病毒感染, «V-» - 無;
«A+» - 帶有抗性抗體, «A-» - 無;
«V+[N]», 其中 N 為感染百分比!
分離成分時, 取得血球的加成:
- «V-, A-» 型: 減少百分之二十;
- «V-, A+» 型: 增加百分之二十五;
- «V+, A-» 型: 增加百分之三十;
- «V+, A+» 型: 增加百分之四十.
Tooltip_CmpTestTubeWithInfectedBlood.cn:
«V+» - 带有僵尸病毒感染, «V-» - 无;
«A+» - 带有抗性抗体, «A-» - 无;
«V+[N]», 其中 N 为感染百分比!
分离成分时, 获得血细胞的加成:
- «V-, A-» 型: 减少百分之二十;
- «V-, A+» 型: 增加百分之二十五;
- «V+, A-» 型: 增加百分之三十;
- «V+, A+» 型: 增加百分之四十.

Tooltip_CmpTestTubeWithTaintedBlood.en: This sample is only suitable for disposal.
Tooltip_CmpTestTubeWithTaintedBlood.ch: 這份樣本只能拿去廢棄處理.
Tooltip_CmpTestTubeWithTaintedBlood.cn: 这份样本只能拿去废弃处理.

Tooltip_LabCorks.cn:

IF A VACCINE OF THIS LEVEL IS ALREADY KNOWN TO ME,

Tooltip_zReVAC_UpgradefulOnTest.cn:

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WildYeastCulture.en: Living wild yeast, ready to harvest into a packet.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WildYeastCulture.ch: 活性野生酵母, 可採集成酵母包.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WildYeastCulture.cn: 活性野生酵母, 可采集成酵母包.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WaxGreenOnions.en: Coat green onions with wax for preservation.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_StartWildYeastCulture.en: Leave the jar open. Wild yeast settles in two days.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_StartWildYeastCulture.ch: 敞開罐子放置. 野生酵母會在兩天內進駐.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_StartWildYeastCulture.cn: 敞开罐子放置. 野生酵母会在两天内进驻.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WildYeastStarter.en: Honey catching wild yeast. Ready in two days.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WildYeastStarter.ch: 正在捕捉野生酵母的蜂蜜. 兩天後完成.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WildYeastStarter.cn: 正在捕捉野生酵母的蜂蜜. 两天后完成.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakeWaxedStopper.en: Shape wax bits into a cork. One seals a bottle of honey or a bottle of mead.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakeWaxedStopper.ch: 把蜂蠟碎塊塑成瓶塞. 一個可密封一瓶蜂蜜或一瓶蜂蜜酒.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakeWaxedStopper.cn: 把蜂蜡碎块塑成瓶塞. 一个可密封一瓶蜂蜜或一瓶蜂蜜酒.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_BottleHoney.en:
Seal a glass bottle holding a full litre of honey with a wax cork.
Pour the honey in first; the cork is used up.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_BottleHoney.ch: 用蜂蠟塞密封裝有滿滿一公升蜂蜜的玻璃瓶. 先把蜂蜜倒進瓶裡; 瓶塞會被消耗掉.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_BottleHoney.cn: 用蜂蜡塞密封装有满满一升蜂蜜的玻璃瓶. 先把蜂蜜倒进瓶里; 瓶塞会被消耗掉.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_StartWildYeastCulture.en: Leave the jar open. Wild yeast settles in two days.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_StartWildYeastCulture.ch: 敞開罐子放置. 野生酵母會在兩天內進駐.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_StartWildYeastCulture.cn: 敞开罐子放置. 野生酵母会在两天内进驻.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_RearQueenLarvae.en: Prepare queen larvae from empty comb, larvae, and royal jelly.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_RearQueenLarvae.ch: 用空蜂巢, 幼蟲和蜂王乳培育蜂后幼蟲.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_RearQueenLarvae.cn: 用空蜂巢, 幼虫和蜂王浆培育蜂后幼虫.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakeSugarWater.en: Stir sugar into a jar of water.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WaxedStopper.en:
A beeswax cork. Bottling honey takes one;
the mead barrel uses one, or a real cork, to seal each bottle it fills.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WaxedStopper.ch: 一個蜂蠟塞. 蜂蜜裝瓶需要一個; 蜂蜜酒桶每裝滿一瓶也會用掉一個, 或改用真正的軟木塞.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WaxedStopper.cn: 一个蜂蜡塞. 蜂蜜装瓶需要一个; 蜂蜜酒桶每装满一瓶也会用掉一个, 或改用真正的软木塞.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_SugarWaterJar.en: Sugar dissolved in water. Feeds hives and catches wild yeast.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_SugarWaterJar.ch: 溶於水中的糖. 可餵養蜂箱, 也能捕捉野生酵母.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_SugarWaterJar.cn: 溶于水中的糖. 可喂养蜂箱, 也能捕捉野生酵母.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_HarvestWildYeast.en: Skim the culture into a yeast packet. Keeps the jar.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_HarvestWildYeast.ch: 把培養物舀進酵母包裡. 罐子會保留下來.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_HarvestWildYeast.cn: 把培养物舀进酵母包里. 罐子会保留下来.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_SealedMead.en:
Mead sealed at the barrel.
Sealed glass keeps it exactly as it was bottled - it will not age or spoil.
Open it with a corkscrew or any sharp tool.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_SealedMead.ch: 在酒桶邊直接密封的蜂蜜酒. 密封的玻璃能讓它維持裝瓶當時的狀態 - 不會繼續熟成, 也不會變質. 用開瓶器或任何尖銳工具即可開封.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_SealedMead.cn: 在酒桶边直接密封的蜂蜜酒. 密封的玻璃能让它保持装瓶当时的状态 - 不会继续熟成, 也不会变质. 用开瓶器或任何尖锐工具即可开封.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WaxGarlic.en: Coat garlic with wax for preservation.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_OpenSealedMead.en:
Pull the seal with a corkscrew, a knife, or anything else with a point.
Once open, drink it or pour it out.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_OpenSealedMead.ch: 用開瓶器, 刀子或其他任何帶尖頭的工具拔開封口. 開封後就能飲用或倒出.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_OpenSealedMead.cn: 用开瓶器, 刀子或其他任何带尖头的工具拔开封口. 开封后就能饮用或倒出.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_ApplyStingSalve.en: Rub one dose of salve over your bee stings. Swelling and venom drop sharply; the relief is immediate.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_ApplyStingSalve.ch: 取一劑藥膏擦在蜂螫上. 腫脹和毒液會明顯消退, 舒緩幾乎立刻生效.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_ApplyStingSalve.cn: 取一剂药膏擦在蜂蜇上. 肿胀和毒液会明显消退, 舒缓几乎立刻生效.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_HoneyBandaid.en: A little wax-paper plaster with a dab of honey. For scrapes and small cuts.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_HoneyBandaid.ch: 一小片蠟紙膠布, 點了蜂蜜. 用來處理擦傷和小割傷.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_HoneyBandaid.cn: 一小片蜡纸胶布, 点了蜂蜜. 用来处理擦伤和小割伤.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakeHoneyBandaids.en: Cut a ripped sheet into strips, wax the backs, dab honey on the pads. Makes two.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakeHoneyBandaids.ch: 把撕裂的布剪成條, 背面塗蠟, 墊面點蜂蜜. 可做兩片.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakeHoneyBandaids.cn: 把撕裂的布剪成条, 背面涂蜡, 垫面点蜂蜜. 可做两片.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakeMedicatedBandage.en: Soak a bandage in one dose of propolis tincture.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakeMedicatedBandage.ch: 把繃帶浸入一劑蜂膠酊.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakeMedicatedBandage.cn: 把绷带浸入一剂蜂胶酊.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakePropolisTincture.en: Grind propolis into water in a clean jar. The bees seal their hive with it; it can seal you too.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakePropolisTincture.ch: 在乾淨的罐子裡把蜂膠磨進水中. 蜜蜂用它封巢, 也能拿來幫你封傷口.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakePropolisTincture.cn: 在干净的罐子里把蜂胶磨进水中. 蜜蜂用它封巢, 也能拿来帮你封伤口.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakeStingSalve.en: Work beeswax, plantain, and honey into an empty jar. The beekeeper's answer to a bad day at the hive.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakeStingSalve.ch: 把蜂蠟、車前草和蜂蜜揉進空罐. 養蜂人應付蜂場糟日子的辦法.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MakeStingSalve.cn: 把蜂蜡、车前草和蜂蜜揉进空罐. 养蜂人应付蜂场糟日子的办法.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MedicatedBandage.en: A bandage soaked in propolis tincture. Binds better than a plain bandage and fights wound infection.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MedicatedBandage.ch: 浸過蜂膠酊的繃帶. 比普通繃帶更服貼, 還能對抗傷口感染.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MedicatedBandage.cn: 浸过蜂胶酊的绷带. 比普通绷带更服帖, 还能对抗伤口感染.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_PropolisTincture.en: Propolis steeped in water - the hive's own antiseptic. Ten wound disinfections; the jar comes back when it runs dry. Use it from the health panel like any disinfectant.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_PropolisTincture.ch: 泡在水裡的蜂膠 - 蜂巢自帶的消毒劑. 可消毒傷口十次; 用盡後罐子會回來. 跟其他消毒劑一樣從健康面板使用.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_PropolisTincture.cn: 泡在水里的蜂胶 - 蜂巢自带的消毒剂. 可消毒伤口十次; 用尽后罐子会回来. 跟其他消毒剂一样从健康面板使用.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_StingSalve.en: Beeswax and plantain worked into a jar of salve. Five applications; each one takes most of the swelling and venom out of your bee stings.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_StingSalve.ch: 蜂蠟和車前草揉成一罐藥膏. 可用五次; 每次都能大幅消除蜂螫的腫脹和毒液.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_StingSalve.cn: 蜂蜡和车前草揉成一罐药膏. 可用五次; 每次都能大幅消除蜂蜇的肿胀和毒液.
