UI_gain_smoker.en: I'm really craving a cigarette right about now...
UI_gain_smoker.ch: 我現在真的很想來根菸…
UI_gain_smoker.cn: 我现在真的很想来根烟…

UI_lost_stoner.en: Been a while since I last smoked some weed...

UI_regain_smoker.en: I feel like having a cigarette...

UI_speech_seed1.en: Do I see a seed in this bud?
UI_speech_seed1.ch: 這朵花蕾裡是不是有顆種子?
UI_speech_seed1.cn: 这朵花蕾里是不是有颗种子?

UI_trait_stonerdesc.en: Does not get sleepy or hungry from smoking pot, but needs more for the same effect.
UI_trait_stonerdesc.ch: 抽大麻不會想睡也不會餓, 但要抽更多才能達到同樣效果.
UI_trait_stonerdesc.cn: 抽大麻不会想睡也不会饿, 但要抽更多才能达到同样效果.

UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.en: You were hooked up on benzos before the apocalypse.
UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.ch: 末日之前你就對苯二氮平類藥物成癮了.
UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.cn: 末日之前你就对苯二氮䓬类药物成瘾了.

UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.en: You had brain damaged. Focusing is now harder.
UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.ch: 你的大腦受過損傷. 現在更難集中注意力.
UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.cn: 你的大脑受过损伤. 现在更难集中注意力.

UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.en: You are interested in drugs and made a little too much researches.
UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.ch: 你對毒品很感興趣, 而且研究得有點過頭.
UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.cn: 你对毒品很感兴趣, 而且研究得有点过头.

UI_KD_Huffer_desc.en: You like to sniff things that shouldn't be...
UI_KD_Huffer_desc.ch: 你喜歡吸一些本來不該吸的東西…
UI_KD_Huffer_desc.cn: 你喜欢吸一些本来不该吸的东西…

UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.en: You took the habit of consumming low stimulant a little too much...
UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.ch: 你養成了服用輕度興奮劑的習慣, 而且用得有點多…
UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.cn: 你养成了服用轻度兴奋剂的习惯, 而且用得有点多…

UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.en: Idk how but you're addicted to raw opium
UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.ch: 不知怎麼的, 你對生鴉片上癮了
UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.cn: 不知怎么的, 你对生鸦片上瘾了

UI_KD_Tweaker_desc.ch: 你已離不開甲基安非他命.
UI_KD_Tweaker_desc.cn: 你已离不开甲基苯丙胺.

UI_item_AdamantiumSkeletonTooltip.en: Your skeleton is indestructable. Doesn't mean you are.
UI_item_AdamantiumSkeletonTooltip.ch: 你的骨骼堅不可摧. 但你可不是.
UI_item_AdamantiumSkeletonTooltip.cn: 你的骨骼坚不可摧. 但你可不是.

UI_item_PlotArmorTooltip.en: Just because you can't see it doesn't mean it's not real.
UI_item_PlotArmorTooltip.ch: 看不見不代表它不存在.
UI_item_PlotArmorTooltip.cn: 看不见不代表它不存在.

UI_options_CelerityDodgeTooltip.en: If you have the Celerity trait you will be notified when dodging a dragdown.
UI_options_CelerityDodgeTooltip.ch: 若你擁有神速特質, 閃避被拖倒時會收到通知.
UI_options_CelerityDodgeTooltip.cn: 若你拥有神速特质, 闪避被拖倒时会收到通知.

UI_options_DeadshotAmmoTooltip.en: If you have the Deadshot trait you will be notified when ammo is restored.
UI_options_DeadshotAmmoTooltip.ch: 若你擁有神射手特質, 恢復彈藥時會收到通知.
UI_options_DeadshotAmmoTooltip.cn: 若你拥有神射手特质, 恢复弹药时会收到通知.

UI_options_InvisibilityAssassinateToolti.en: If you have the Invisibility trait you will be notified when triggering an assassination.
UI_options_InvisibilityAssassinateToolti.ch: 若你擁有隱形特質, 觸發暗殺時會收到通知.
UI_options_InvisibilityAssassinateToolti.cn: 若你拥有隐形特质, 触发暗杀时会收到通知.

UI_options_PopClawsTooltip.en: If you have the Adamantium trait you will be notified when claws are extended.
UI_options_PopClawsTooltip.ch: 若你擁有亞德曼合金特質, 伸出利爪時會收到通知.
UI_options_PopClawsTooltip.cn: 若你拥有艾德曼合金特质, 伸出利爪时会收到通知.

UI_options_TelekinesisPushTooltip.en: If you have the Telekenisis trait you will be notified when pushing a zombie back.
UI_options_TelekinesisPushTooltip.ch: 若你擁有念力特質, 推開殭屍時會收到通知.
UI_options_TelekinesisPushTooltip.cn: 若你拥有念力特质, 推开僵尸时会收到通知.

UI_trait_AdamantiumDesc.en:
Start with an indestructable adamantium skeleton.
Pop adamantium claws when attacking unarmed.
UI_trait_AdamantiumDesc.ch:
開局即擁有堅不可摧的亞德曼合金骨骼.
徒手攻擊時彈出亞德曼合金爪.
UI_trait_AdamantiumDesc.cn:
开局即拥有坚不可摧的艾德曼合金骨骼.
徒手攻击时弹出艾德曼合金爪.

UI_trait_CelerityDesc.en:
Superhuman speed and reaction time.
Faster combat and recovery animations.
Faster movement and timed actions.
Chance to dodge zombie attacks.
Dextrous
UI_trait_CelerityDesc.ch:
超乎常人的速度與反應.
戰鬥與恢復動作更快.
移動與計時動作更快.
有機率閃避殭屍攻擊.
眼疾手快
UI_trait_CelerityDesc.cn:
超乎常人的速度与反应.
战斗与恢复动作更快.
移动与计时动作更快.
有几率闪避僵尸攻击.
眼疾手快

UI_trait_DeadshotDesc.en:
One shot. One kill. Every time.
Firearms degrade more slowly, and may restore ammo when fired.
Desensitized
Eagle Eyed
UI_trait_DeadshotDesc.ch:
一槍一命, 從不落空.
槍械磨損更慢, 射擊時可能恢復彈藥.
麻木不仁
目光銳利
UI_trait_DeadshotDesc.cn:
一枪一命, 从不落空.
枪械磨损更慢, 射击时可能恢复弹药.
麻木不仁
目光锐利

UI_trait_EideticDesc.en:
Perfect recall and comprehension.
Gain skill levels by reading skill books.
Automatically know all recipes.
Fast Learner
Fast Reader
UI_trait_EideticDesc.ch:
記憶與理解力完美無缺.
閱讀技能書即可提升技能等級.
自動學會所有配方.
學習神速
閱讀神速
UI_trait_EideticDesc.cn:
记忆与理解力完美无缺.
阅读技能书即可提升技能等级.
自动学会所有配方.
学习神速
阅读神速

UI_trait_FlightDesc.en:
Sky roads are faster than walking.
Double tap the vehicle key to toggle flight mode. Page Up/Down to change elevation.
Constant feather fall.
UI_trait_FlightDesc.ch:
走天路比走路快.
連按兩次載具鍵切換飛行模式. 用 Page Up/Down 調整高度.
永久羽落效果.
UI_trait_FlightDesc.cn:
走天路比走路快.
连按两次车辆键切换飞行模式. 用 Page Up/Down 调整高度.
永久羽落效果.

UI_trait_HammerDesc.en:
Explosive hammer strikes.
Will blow the pants right off you.
Works with blunt weapons.
UI_trait_HammerDesc.ch:
爆炸性的錘擊.
威力大到能把你的褲子轟飛.
適用於鈍器.
UI_trait_HammerDesc.cn:
爆炸性的锤击.
威力大到能把你的裤子轰飞.
适用于钝器.

UI_trait_InvisibilityDesc.en:
Become invisible while sneaking.
Assassinate enemies while invisible.
Graceful
Inconspicuous
UI_trait_InvisibilityDesc.ch:
潛行時變得隱形.
隱形時可暗殺敵人.
身輕如燕
毫不起眼
UI_trait_InvisibilityDesc.cn:
潜行时变得隐形.
隐形时可暗杀敌人.
身轻如燕
毫不起眼

UI_trait_LaserEyesDesc.en:
Shoot fricken' laser beams out of your eyes.
Wear any eyewear to activate. Equip from the hotbar, then point and shoot.
Eagle Eyed
UI_trait_LaserEyesDesc.ch:
從眼睛射出該死的雷射光束.
戴上任何眼部裝備即可啟用. 從快捷欄裝備後瞄準射擊.
目光銳利
UI_trait_LaserEyesDesc.cn:
从眼睛射出该死的激光光束.
戴上任何眼部装备即可启用. 从快捷栏装备后瞄准射击.
目光锐利

UI_trait_LastStandDesc.en: Explode in a last stand of defiance when about to be dragged down.
UI_trait_LastStandDesc.ch: 即將被拖倒時, 以最後的反抗引爆自身.
UI_trait_LastStandDesc.cn: 即将被拖倒时, 以最后的反抗引爆自身.

UI_trait_OnePunchDesc.en:
One punch. Everything dies.
Obliterate doors, trees, zombies, and zombie hordes with a single unarmed strike.
UI_trait_OnePunchDesc.ch:
一拳. 萬物皆滅.
徒手一擊即可粉碎門扉, 樹木, 殭屍與整群屍潮.
UI_trait_OnePunchDesc.cn:
一拳. 万物皆灭.
徒手一击即可粉碎门扉, 树木, 僵尸与整群尸潮.

UI_trait_PlotArmorDesc.en:
Start with nigh-impenetrable plot armor.
Just don't forget to equip it.
UI_trait_PlotArmorDesc.ch:
開局即擁有幾乎無法穿透的主角光環.
只是別忘了把它裝備上.
UI_trait_PlotArmorDesc.cn:
开局即拥有几乎无法穿透的主角光环.
只是别忘了把它装备上.

UI_trait_PsychoticDesc.en:
Violence is a part of you now.
Increased boredom.
Boost mood with every kill.
UI_trait_PsychoticDesc.ch:
暴力已成為你的一部分.
更容易感到無聊.
每次擊殺都能提振心情.
UI_trait_PsychoticDesc.cn:
暴力已成为你的一部分.
更容易感到无聊.
每次击杀都能提振心情.

UI_trait_RegenerationDesc.en:
Wounds heal in minutes.
Never become diseased or infected.
Immune to zombification.
Fast Healer
UI_trait_RegenerationDesc.ch:
傷口幾分鐘就癒合.
永不生病或感染.
免疫殭屍化.
快速恢復
UI_trait_RegenerationDesc.cn:
伤口几分钟就愈合.
永不生病或感染.
免疫僵尸化.
快速恢复

UI_trait_TelekinesisDesc.en:
Passively push zombies away with telekinetic shields.
Shout to project devastating telekinetic blasts.
Drains endurance; will fail if you get too tired.
UI_trait_TelekinesisDesc.ch:
被動以念力護盾推開殭屍.
大喊即可發出毀滅性的念力衝擊波.
會消耗耐力; 太過疲勞時將會失敗.
UI_trait_TelekinesisDesc.cn:
被动以念力护盾推开僵尸.
大喊即可发出毁灭性的念力冲击波.
会消耗耐力; 太过疲劳时将会失败.

UI_trait_ThunderstrikeDesc.en:
Shout to summon the wrath of the heavens.
Only works outside.
Beware of fires!
UI_trait_ThunderstrikeDesc.ch:
大喊即可召喚天罰.
僅能在室外使用.
小心引發火災!
UI_trait_ThunderstrikeDesc.cn:
大喊即可召唤天罚.
仅能在室外使用.
小心引发火灾!

UI_trait_UnstoppableDesc.en:
Sprint straight through your enemies. They will regret it.
Just don't run out of endurance in the middle of a horde.
UI_trait_UnstoppableDesc.ch:
直接衝過敵人. 他們會後悔的.
只是別在屍潮中間耗盡耐力.
UI_trait_UnstoppableDesc.cn:
直接冲过敌人. 他们会后悔的.
只是别在尸潮中间耗尽耐力.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.en: It feels your fear, and hates it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.ch: 它感受到你的恐懼, 並為此憎惡.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.cn: 它感受到你的恐惧, 并为此憎恶.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.en: Just a tool. Nothing has marked it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.ch: 不過是件工具. 還沒有任何事物在它身上留下痕跡.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.cn: 不过是件工具. 还没有任何事物在它身上留下痕迹.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.en: Rain and red run together. Nothing sticks.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.ch: 雨水與血色一同流下. 什麼也沾不住.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.cn: 雨水与血色一同流下. 什么也沾不住.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.en: Late and still. It dreams of edges it has met.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.ch: 夜深而靜. 它夢見自己交手過的每一道鋒刃.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.cn: 夜深而静. 它梦见自己交手过的每一道锋刃.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.en: It won't come clean. It doesn't try.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.ch: 它擦不乾淨. 它也不打算擦.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.cn: 它擦不干净. 它也不打算擦.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.en: Idle and indoors. It dozes against your side.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.ch: 閒置於室內. 它靠在你身側打盹.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.cn: 闲置于室内. 它靠在你身侧打盹.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.en: Blooded in the dark. It pulls toward the next one.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中飲過血. 它拉扯著奔向下一個.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中饮过血. 它拉扯着奔向下一个.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.en: Your dread strikes a spark in it, then nothing.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.ch: 你的恐懼在它體內擦出一星火花, 隨即歸於虛無.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.cn: 你的恐惧在它体内擦出一星火花, 随即归于虚无.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.en: The light goes. It feels the long dark coming on.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.ch: 天光將盡. 它感覺到漫長的黑暗正在逼近.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.cn: 天光将尽. 它感觉到漫长的黑暗正在逼近.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.en: Slick to the grip and full — and hungry anyway.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.ch: 握柄濕滑, 已然飽足——卻依舊飢渴.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.cn: 握柄湿滑, 已然饱足——却依旧饥渴.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.en: Grey at the edges — you've lasted the night. It eases.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.ch: 天邊泛起灰白——你熬過了這一夜. 它鬆弛下來.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.cn: 天边泛起灰白——你熬过了这一夜. 它松弛下来.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.en: Quiet warmth in the daylight. Content, briefly.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.ch: 日光下靜靜地溫著. 短暫地心滿意足.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.cn: 日光下静静地温着. 短暂地心满意足.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.en: Half-fed in the dark, casting for more.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中半飽, 仍四處搜尋著下一口.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中半饱, 仍四处搜寻着下一口.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.en: No voice in it — only the weight of the dead.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.ch: 它體內沒有聲音——只有亡者的重量.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.cn: 它体内没有声音——只有亡者的重量.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.en: Quiet — but it counts the dead it has made.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.ch: 靜默——但它清點著自己造就的亡者.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.cn: 静默——但它清点着自己造就的亡者.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.en: It won't settle. It paces in your hand.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.ch: 它靜不下來. 在你手中來回踱步.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.cn: 它静不下来. 在你手中来回踱步.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.en: The rain takes the blood. It lets go, for now.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.ch: 雨水帶走血跡. 它暫時鬆手了.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.cn: 雨水带走血迹. 它暂时松手了.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.en: Awake to the work now. It wants the rhythm to hold.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.ch: 它已為這場活計醒來. 它想讓這節奏持續下去.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.cn: 它已为这场活计醒来. 它想让这节奏持续下去.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.en: Clean and sheltered, it forgets what it saw.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.ch: 潔淨而有遮蔽, 它忘了自己看過什麼.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.cn: 洁净而有遮蔽, 它忘了自己看过什么.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.en: It rings between every blow. It does not want to stop.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.ch: 每一擊之間它都在鳴響. 它不想停下.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.cn: 每一击之间它都在鸣响. 它不想停下.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.en: Resting. Patient. It has all the time there is.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.ch: 歇息. 耐心. 它擁有世上全部的時間.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.cn: 歇息. 耐心. 它拥有世上全部的时间.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.en: Heavier than it was. It blames your tired arm.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.ch: 比先前更沉了. 它怪罪你疲憊的手臂.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.cn: 比先前更沉了. 它怪罪你疲惫的手臂.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.en: Clean under a dead sky. It wants that to change.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.ch: 在死寂的天空下潔淨無染. 它想改變這一點.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.cn: 在死寂的天空下洁净无染. 它想改变这一点.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.en: Too much death, too fast — it shudders to keep up.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.ch: 死亡太多, 太快——它顫抖著才勉強跟上.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.cn: 死亡太多, 太快——它颤抖着才勉强跟上.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.en: The dark leans in. It almost understands why.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.ch: 黑暗傾身逼近. 它幾乎明白了緣由.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.cn: 黑暗倾身逼近. 它几乎明白了缘由.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.en: The blood leaves a warmth it can't name.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.ch: 血留下一種它無法名狀的溫熱.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.cn: 血留下一种它无法名状的温热.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.en: Awake in the dark, listening with you.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中醒著, 與你一同傾聽.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中醒着, 与你一同倾听.

UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL.en: Double-click food eats the whole item

UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.en: When enabled, double-clicking food uses the vanilla behavior and eats the whole item instead of smart partial eating.
UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.ch: 啟用後, 雙擊食物將採用原版行為, 直接吃掉整份, 而非智慧分次進食.
UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.cn: 启用后, 双击食物将采用原版行为, 直接吃掉整份, 而非智能分次进食.

UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.ch: 搜尋: 忽略附帶種子
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.cn: 搜寻: 忽略附带种子

UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.en: Singleplayer: controlled only by Mod Options and overrides Sandbox. Multiplayer: controlled by the server Sandbox setting. When enabled, wild crops found through foraging still give the food item, but the automatically generated extra seed items are ignored.
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.ch: 單人遊戲: 僅由模組選項控制, 並覆寫沙盒設定. 多人遊戲: 由伺服器沙盒設定控制. 啟用後, 搜尋找到的野生作物仍會給予食物物品, 但自動產生的額外種子物品會被忽略.
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.cn: 单人游戏: 仅由模组选项控制, 并覆盖沙盒设置. 多人游戏: 由服务器沙盒设置控制. 启用后, 搜寻找到的野生作物仍会给予食物物品, 但自动产生的额外种子物品会被忽略.

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.en: Reload cleanup options are mutually exclusive: enable either dropping leftovers or deleting leftovers, never both. Deleting permanently removes the leftover item from your inventory.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.ch: 裝填清理選項互斥: 丟棄殘件與刪除殘件只能擇一啟用, 不可同時開啟. 刪除會將殘件從你的物品欄中永久移除.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.cn: 装填清理选项互斥: 丢弃残件与删除残件只能择一启用, 不可同时开启. 删除会将残件从你的物品栏中永久移除.

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.ch: 裝填鍵: 刪除損壞殘件
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.cn: 装填键: 删除损坏残件

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.en: Optional cleanup. Whenever a melee reload is executed by quick reload or by selecting a weapon from the hold-reload radial menu, broken melee leftovers are permanently deleted from the main inventory. This removes the leftover item from your inventory and cannot be used together with Drop Broken Leftovers.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.ch: 選用的清理功能. 每當透過快速裝填, 或從按住裝填鍵開啟的環形選單中選擇武器而執行近戰裝填時, 損壞的近戰殘件會從主物品欄中永久刪除. 此選項會將殘件從你的物品欄移除, 且不可與「丟棄損壞殘件」同時使用.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.cn: 可选的清理功能. 每当通过快速装填, 或从按住装填键打开的环形菜单中选择武器而执行近战装填时, 损坏的近战残件会从主物品栏中永久删除. 此选项会将残件从你的物品栏移除, 且不可与“丢弃损坏残件”同时使用.

UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.en: When enabled, combat-stance movement speed uses the selected Nimble limit only if your real Nimble level is higher. XP is not reduced.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.ch: 啟用後, 只有在你實際的靈活等級高於所選上限時, 戰鬥姿態的移動速度才會套用該上限. 經驗值不會減少.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.cn: 启用后, 只有在你实际的灵活等级高于所选上限时, 战斗姿态的移动速度才会应用该上限. 经验值不会减少.

UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.en: Sets the maximum effective Nimble level for combat-stance movement speed. If your real Nimble level is equal or lower, nothing is changed.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.ch: 設定戰鬥姿態移動速度所採用的靈活等級上限. 若你實際的靈活等級等於或低於此值, 則不會有任何變化.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.cn: 设定战斗姿态移动速度所采用的灵活等级上限. 若你实际的灵活等级等于或低于此值, 则不会有任何变化.

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.en: Double-click traps to add best bait
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.ch: 雙擊陷阱自動放入最佳誘餌
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.cn: 双击陷阱自动放入最佳诱饵

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.en: Double-click an empty trap to automatically use the best available fresh bait from your inventory. Rabbit bait is preferred when the trap can catch rabbits.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.ch: 雙擊空陷阱時, 自動從你的物品欄取用最佳的新鮮誘餌. 若該陷阱能捕捉兔子, 會優先使用兔子誘餌.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.cn: 双击空陷阱时, 自动从你的物品栏取用最佳的新鲜诱饵. 若该陷阱能捕捉兔子, 会优先使用兔子诱饵.

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.en: After placing a trap, automatically starts placing another trap of the same type if one is still available in your inventory.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.ch: 放置陷阱後, 若物品欄中仍有同類型陷阱, 會自動接著放置下一個.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.cn: 放置陷阱后, 若物品栏中仍有同类型陷阱, 会自动接着放置下一个.

UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT.en: Color trap highlight by bait state
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT.ch: 依誘餌狀態顯示陷阱高亮顏色
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT.cn: 依诱饵状态显示陷阱高亮颜色

UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TT.en: Hovered traps use different highlight colors depending on whether they are baited, empty, or sprung.
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TT.ch: 滑鼠移過陷阱時, 會依已放餌, 空置或已觸發等狀態顯示不同的高亮顏色.
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TT.cn: 鼠标移过陷阱时, 会依已放饵, 空置或已触发等状态显示不同的高亮颜色.

UI_BT_OPTION_NEARBY_HIGHLIGHT_TT.en: Continuously highlights nearby traps around you. Disabled by default for performance and visual clarity.
UI_BT_OPTION_NEARBY_HIGHLIGHT_TT.ch: 持續高亮你周圍的陷阱. 為兼顧效能與畫面清晰, 預設為停用.
UI_BT_OPTION_NEARBY_HIGHLIGHT_TT.cn: 持续高亮你周围的陷阱. 为兼顾性能与画面清晰, 默认为禁用.

UI_BCI_ShowCoverageChanges_tooltip.en: Show compact body-part warmth, wind, and protection changes in wear previews.
UI_BCI_ShowCoverageChanges_tooltip.ch: 在穿著預覽中以精簡形式顯示各身體部位的保溫, 防風和防護變化.
UI_BCI_ShowCoverageChanges_tooltip.cn: 在穿着预览中以精简形式显示各身体部位的保温, 防风和防护变化.

UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison.ch: 穿著預覽需按住快捷鍵
UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison.cn: 穿着预览需按住快捷键

UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison_tooltip.en: Only show the inventory-hover wear preview while the keybind is pressed.
UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison_tooltip.ch: 僅在按住快捷鍵時才顯示物品欄懸停的穿著預覽.
UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison_tooltip.cn: 仅在按住快捷键时才显示物品栏悬停的穿着预览.

UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_DebugOutput_T.en: Controls diagnostic output for troubleshooting. Detailed logging may affect performance, so enable it only while reproducing an issue.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_DebugOutput_T.ch: 控制用於排除問題的診斷輸出. 詳細記錄可能影響效能, 請僅在重現問題時啟用.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_DebugOutput_T.cn: 控制用于排查问题的诊断输出. 详细日志可能影响性能, 请仅在复现问题时启用.

UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreDisman.en: Returns materials obtained by dismantling an item to the container the dismantled item came from.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreDisman.ch: 將拆解物品所得的材料放回被拆解物品原本所在的容器.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreDisman.cn: 将拆解物品所得的材料放回被拆解物品原本所在的容器.

UI_Btn_CharLoad_tooltip.en: You need to quit and reload to synchronize your inventory and traits
UI_Btn_CharLoad_tooltip.ch: 你需要退出並重新載入才能同步你的物品欄與特質.
UI_Btn_CharLoad_tooltip.cn: 你需要退出并重新加载才能同步你的物品栏与特质.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_TransferMism.cn: 该转移不再匹配服务器状态.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_TransferNotA.en: That transfer is no longer active.

UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreOpenin.en: Return Items after Opening or Unpacking
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreOpenin.ch: 開啟或拆封後歸還物品
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreOpenin.cn: 打开或拆包后归还物品

UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreOpenin.en: Returns items obtained by opening containers or unpacking boxes to their original container. Leftovers and empty containers produced by opening and eating are returned regardless of this setting.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreOpenin.ch: 將開啟容器或拆封箱盒所得的物品放回原本的容器. 開啟並食用所產生的剩料與空容器不受此設定影響, 一律歸還.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreOpenin.cn: 将打开容器或拆包箱盒所得的物品放回原来的容器. 打开并食用所产生的剩料与空容器不受此设置影响, 一律归还.

UI_DRJ_Options_showXPWindow_tooltip.ch: 顯示可移動的經驗值條與經驗值飄字. <LINE>停用時, 多人遊戲的經驗值紀錄仍會持續運作.

UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_AllThumbs_Bonu.en: Thief: Decreases stealing success chance and maximum item weight, and increases fumble chance.

UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_Clumsy_Bonus.en: Thief: Greatly decreases the duration of stealth.
UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_Clumsy_Bonus.ch: 盜賊: 大幅縮短隱身的持續時間.
UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_Clumsy_Bonus.cn: 盗贼: 大幅缩短隐身的持续时间.

UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_Conspicuous_Bo.en: Thief: Makes it harder to hide and slightly decreases the duration of stealth.
UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_Conspicuous_Bo.ch: 盜賊: 更難隱藏身形, 並略微縮短隱身的持續時間.
UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_Conspicuous_Bo.cn: 盗贼: 更难隐藏身形, 并略微缩短隐身的持续时间.

UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_Dextrous_Bonus.en: Thief: Increases stealing success chance and maximum item weight, and decreases fumble chance.
UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_Dextrous_Bonus.ch: 盜賊: 提高偷竊成功率與可偷竊物品的重量上限, 並降低失誤機率.
UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_Dextrous_Bonus.cn: 盗贼: 提高偷窃成功率和可偷窃物品的重量上限, 并降低失误概率.

UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_EagleEyed_Bonu.en: Thief: Increases the chance that zombies carry items and that valuable items can be stolen.
UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_EagleEyed_Bonu.ch: 盜賊: 提高殭屍身上帶有物品的機率, 以及偷到貴重物品的機率.

UI_trait_slowpoke._note: issue #125：MoreTraits - Dynamic 的 MoreTraits - Dynamic.lua:284（有效分支 42.17，該檔無任何 Lua 長註解，確認為活程式碼）在移除 gimp 特質時以 getText("UI_trait_slowpoke") 顯示 halo 文字，但該鍵未定義於任何檔、任何語言。上游 EN 的 UI_trait_gimp 即為 "Slowpoke"，可判定作者誤植鍵名，故值與 UI_trait_gimp 一致（磨磨蹭蹭），非自行造詞。【同批已撤】UI_trait_lightdrink/harddrink(+desc) 曾一併登記，後查出唯一 producer MoreTraitsMainCreationMethods.lua:413-414 位於該檔第 1 行 --[[ 至第 426 行 --]] 的整檔註解內、永不執行，且 ToadTraits.txt 未以 character_trait_definition 補回，屬死鍵故移除。教訓：以 regex 掃 getText( 判定活引用時必須先排除 Lua 註解區塊。

UI_HCB_GH_OutQLBrooding.en: A new queen is growing - ready in about %1h.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1c.en: Yeast: %1 uses of a Yeast packet, or a Wild Yeast Culture.

UI_HCB_GH_TipOutNextComb.ch: 週期進度: %1h / 共 %2h, 速度 %3%%.
UI_HCB_GH_TipOutNextComb.cn: 周期进度: %1h / 共 %2h, 速度 %3%%.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCombs.en: Filled honeycombs stored in the hive: %1 of %2.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSameFruit.en: Add more %1 to keep this batch on one fruit profile.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSameFruit.cn: 再加入更多 %1, 让这一批维持单一水果风味.

UI_HCB_MB_NeedFruit.en: %1 more fruit (or empty the barrel and brew plain)
UI_HCB_MB_NeedFruit.ch: 還需要 %1 水果 (或清空發酵桶, 改釀原味)

UI_HCB_GH_TipSeasonRates.cn: 全速运行时, 大约每 %1 小时会填满一块新蜂巢; 蜂箱最多可储存 %2 块蜂巢和 %3 只幼虫.

UI_HCB_GH_TipQueenClickCage.en: You have a cage ready - click her to remove her now.
UI_HCB_GH_TipQueenClickCage.ch: 你已經備好蜂后籠 - 點選她就能立刻取出.
UI_HCB_GH_TipQueenClickCage.cn: 你已经备好蜂后笼 - 点击她就能立刻取出.

UI_HCB_Hive_DebugAdvanced.ch: 蜂箱時間已推進 %1 小時.
UI_HCB_Hive_DebugAdvanced.cn: 蜂箱时间已推进 %1 小时.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1a.en: Honey: %1. Click the Honey row to pour from what you carry, or drop one container on it. Bottles of honey work; you keep the glass.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1a.ch: 蜂蜜: %1. 點選蜂蜜那一列, 就能從身上攜帶的容器倒入, 或把單一容器拖放到上面. 瓶裝蜂蜜也可以; 玻璃瓶會留給你.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1a.cn: 蜂蜜: %1. 点击蜂蜜那一行, 就能从身上携带的容器倒入, 或把单一容器拖放到上面. 瓶装蜂蜜也可以; 玻璃瓶会留给你.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyFull.en: It is full right now - another jar would not fit.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyFull.ch: 目前已經滿了 - 再一罐也裝不下.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyFull.cn: 当前已经满了 - 再一罐也装不下.

UI_HCB_GH_CondFull.en: Storage is full - harvest to make room.
UI_HCB_GH_CondFull.ch: 儲存空間已滿 - 採收以騰出空間.
UI_HCB_GH_CondFull.cn: 储存空间已满 - 采收以腾出空间.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBrood.en: Brood cell. These larvae hatch into worker bees.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBrood.ch: 育蟲巢房. 這些幼蟲會孵化成工蜂.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBrood.cn: 育虫巢房. 这些幼虫会孵化成工蜂.

UI_HCB_GH_CondFog.en: Heavy fog is slowing the bees.
UI_HCB_GH_CondFog.ch: 濃霧正在減慢蜜蜂的速度.
UI_HCB_GH_CondFog.cn: 浓雾正在减慢蜜蜂的速度.

UI_HCB_MB_SayAddedFruit.en: Added fruit to the barrel. Staged fruit: %1.
UI_HCB_MB_SayAddedFruit.ch: 已將水果加入發酵桶. 已投入水果: %1.
UI_HCB_MB_SayAddedFruit.cn: 已将水果加入发酵桶. 已投入水果: %1.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply2.en: While any is left it stands in for flowers when forage is thin.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply2.ch: 只要還有剩, 蜜源稀少時它就會代替花朵.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply2.cn: 只要还有剩, 蜜源稀少时它就会代替花朵.

UI_HCB_MB_SayBottlingFailed.en: The mead could not be bottled, so nothing was used.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBottlingFailed.ch: 蜂蜜酒無法裝瓶, 因此沒有消耗任何材料.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBottlingFailed.cn: 蜂蜜酒无法装瓶, 因此没有消耗任何材料.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3c.en: It comes out sealed at the stage it was poured. Sealed mead never ages or spoils.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3c.ch: 產出時會密封在裝瓶當下的階段. 密封蜂蜜酒永遠不會繼續熟成或變質.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3c.cn: 产出时会密封在装瓶当下的阶段. 密封蜂蜜酒永远不会继续熟成或变质.

UI_HCB_MB_SayFruitStuck.en: That fruit could not be removed from inventory.
UI_HCB_MB_SayFruitStuck.ch: 無法從物品欄移除那個水果.
UI_HCB_MB_SayFruitStuck.cn: 无法从物品栏移除那个水果.

UI_HCB_GH_CondSyrupWorking.en: Sugar water is standing in for the flowers.

UI_HCB_MB_SayContainerNoHoney.en: That container has no honey left.
UI_HCB_MB_SayContainerNoHoney.ch: 那個容器裡沒有蜂蜜了.
UI_HCB_MB_SayContainerNoHoney.cn: 那个容器里没有蜂蜜了.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFruitRecipe.en: There's no mead recipe for that fruit.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFruitRecipe.ch: 那種水果沒有對應的蜂蜜酒配方.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFruitRecipe.cn: 那种水果没有对应的蜂蜜酒配方.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellQueenHours.en: The queen. About %1h of laying left. Use Remove Queen to cage her.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellQueenHours.ch: 蜂后. 大約還剩 %1h 的產卵時間. 使用「取出蜂后」把她裝籠.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellQueenHours.cn: 蜂后. 大约还剩 %1h 的产卵时间. 使用“取出蜂后”把她装笼.

UI_HCB_GH_CondKeeperBoon.ch: 你的養蜂人手藝正在發揮作用.
UI_HCB_GH_CondKeeperBoon.cn: 你的养蜂人手艺正在发挥作用.

UI_HCB_MB_TimelineYoung.en: Young mead now - fully fermented in %1.
UI_HCB_MB_TimelineYoung.ch: 目前是新酒 - %1 後完全發酵.
UI_HCB_MB_TimelineYoung.cn: 当前是新酒 - %1 后完全发酵.

UI_HCB_MB_TipReadyBottleSealed.en: Click to bottle one %1 (%2 a bottle).

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSeal.en: You need a cork or a wax cork to seal the bottle.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSeal.ch: 你需要一個軟木塞或蜂蠟塞來密封瓶子.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSeal.cn: 你需要一个软木塞或蜂蜡塞来密封瓶子.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedHoney.en: You need a container with honey.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedHoney.ch: 你需要一個裝有蜂蜜的容器.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedHoney.cn: 你需要一个装有蜂蜜的容器.

UI_HCB_MB_SayDrawFailedSealed.en: The barrel poured a bottle, but you no longer had an empty bottle and a seal for it.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow4.en: Sugar water left on the ground beside a working hive gets drunk too - the bees come out and empty it over the next few hours.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow4.cn: 放在运行中蜂箱旁地上的糖水也会被喝掉 - 蜜蜂会飞出来, 在接下来几小时内把它喝完.

UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodSmoked.en: Smoke calms the bees for about %1h and stops work on the comb. Safe to harvest.
UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodSmoked.ch: 煙霧會讓蜜蜂鎮靜大約 %1h, 並停止蜂巢作業. 這時可以安全採收.

UI_HCB_MB_TipHoney3.en: Bottles of honey work too - you keep the glass.
UI_HCB_MB_TipHoney3.ch: 瓶裝蜂蜜也可以 - 玻璃瓶會留給你.
UI_HCB_MB_TipHoney3.cn: 瓶装蜂蜜也可以 - 玻璃瓶会留给你.

UI_HCB_GH_TipOutLarvae.en: Larvae and bees grow with the same daily cycle as comb.

UI_HCB_MB_TipNextBottle.ch: 下一瓶還要 %1 才會完成.
UI_HCB_MB_TipNextBottle.cn: 下一瓶还要 %1 才会完成.

UI_HCB_Hive_FedSugarWaterSplash.cn: 倒入了一点糖水 - 勉强只够沾湿槽底.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S5a.en: Start Wild Yeast Culture from a jar of honey or sugar water. Two days later, harvest it for a Yeast packet.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S5a.ch: 用一罐蜂蜜或糖水開始培養野生酵母培養物. 兩天後採收, 就能得到一包酵母.

UI_HCB_MB_SayContainerNoWater.en: That container has no water left.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellEmpty.ch: 空蜂巢. 隨著蜂群成長, 蜜蜂會在這裡築巢.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellEmpty.cn: 空蜂巢. 随着蜂群成长, 蜜蜂会在这里筑巢.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingSmoked.en: A half-built comb. The bees will not touch it until the smoke clears.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingSmoked.ch: 一塊蓋了一半的蜂巢. 煙霧散去前蜜蜂不會去動它.

UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineStages.cn: 批次开始后, 时间轴会显示在这里: 新酒, 完全发酵, 熟成, 最后变质.

UI_HCB_GH_OutRJProducing.ch: 蜂王乳正在形成 - 大約還要 %1 小時.
UI_HCB_GH_OutRJProducing.cn: 蜂王浆正在形成 - 大约还要 %1 小时.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedWater.en: You need a container with water.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedWater.ch: 你需要一個裝著水的容器.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedWater.cn: 你需要一个装着水的容器.

UI_HCB_Hive_PausedNoInteract.en: Unpause the game to work the hive.
UI_HCB_Hive_PausedNoInteract.ch: 取消遊戲暫停後才能操作蜂箱.
UI_HCB_Hive_PausedNoInteract.cn: 取消游戏暂停后才能操作蜂箱.

UI_HCB_GH_TipOutQueen.ch: 產卵時間剩下正好 %1 小時.
UI_HCB_GH_TipOutQueen.cn: 产卵时间剩下正好 %1 小时.

UI_HCB_Hive_FeedTankFull.cn: 蜂箱的糖水已满 - 共 %1 升. 得先让蜜蜂喝掉一些.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1e.en: Start Fermenting unlocks when every row is full. Every batch is %1 bottles.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1e.ch: 每一行都裝滿後, 開始發酵就會解鎖. 每個批次都是 %1 瓶.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3a.ch: 每瓶需要一個空玻璃瓶, 外加一個軟木塞或蜂蠟塞 (2 個蜂蠟碎塊).
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3a.cn: 每瓶需要一个空玻璃瓶, 外加一个软木塞或蜂蜡塞 (2 个蜂蜡碎块).

UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineIdle1.en: The batch's timeline shows here once it starts.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineIdle1.ch: 批次開始後, 它的時間軸會顯示在這裡.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineIdle1.cn: 批次开始后, 它的时间轴会显示在这里.

UI_HCB_MB_TipFruit1.en: Optional. %1 of one kind of fruit flavors the batch - or none for plain mead.
UI_HCB_MB_TipFruit1.ch: 選用. 加入 %1 的單一種水果可為批次調味 - 不加則是原味蜂蜜酒.
UI_HCB_MB_TipFruit1.cn: 可选. 加入 %1 的单一种水果可为批次调味 - 不加则是原味蜂蜜酒.

UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyFull.en: The honey side is already full.

UI_HCB_GH_SkyRule1.ch: 下雨和下雪會讓工作暫停.
UI_HCB_GH_SkyRule1.cn: 下雨和下雪会让工作暂停.

UI_HCB_GH_OutNoQueen.en: No queen - nothing new is being made.
UI_HCB_GH_OutNoQueen.ch: 沒有蜂后 - 不會產出任何新東西.
UI_HCB_GH_OutNoQueen.cn: 没有蜂后 - 不会产出任何新东西.

UI_HCB_Hive_SmokerOutOfFuel.en: Your Bee Smoker is out of fuel. Refuel it and light it again.
UI_HCB_Hive_SmokerOutOfFuel.ch: 你的蜂箱燻煙器沒燃料了. 重新裝填燃料再點燃它.
UI_HCB_Hive_SmokerOutOfFuel.cn: 你的蜂箱熏烟器没燃料了. 重新装填燃料再点燃它.

UI_HCB_GH_BtnInsertQueenTip.en: Place a Queen Bee or caged queen from your inventory to start the hive.

UI_HCB_GH_BtnInsertQueenTip.cn: 从物品栏放入蜂后或笼中的蜂后来启动蜂箱.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyNoJar.en: You are not carrying any sugar water.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyNoJar.ch: 你身上沒有帶任何糖水.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyNoJar.cn: 你身上没有带任何糖水.

UI_HCB_GH_OutRJReady.en: Royal jelly is ready - click its cell to collect.
UI_HCB_GH_OutRJReady.ch: 蜂王乳已經完成 - 點選它的格子來收取.
UI_HCB_GH_OutRJReady.cn: 蜂王浆已经完成 - 点击它的格子来收取.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBroodTake.en: Click to take it - larvae make good fishing bait.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBroodTake.ch: 點選以取走 - 幼蟲是不錯的釣餌.

UI_HCB_GH_BtnSmokeTip.cn: 镇静蜜蜂, 让你可以安全地处理蜂巢. 会烧掉熏烟器五分之一的燃料, 而且烟雾持续期间蜂箱会停止建造.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S5b.cn: 或者把一罐蜂蜜或糖水放在地上: 它会自己酸化成酵母引子, 除非附近有蜂箱近到会把它喝掉.

UI_HCB_GH_CondSuboptimal.en: The temperature is off - work is a little slower.

UI_HCB_GH_CondSuboptimal.cn: 温度不太对 - 工作稍微慢了一些.

UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleFillingSealed.en: Still fermenting - first bottle ready in %1.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow1.ch: 影響這個數字的因素: 下雨或下雪會停下所有工作, 濃霧會拖慢速度, 嚴寒會讓蜂箱進入冬眠, 酷熱則會消耗蜜蜂的體力.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow1.cn: 影响这个数字的因素: 下雨或下雪会停下所有工作, 浓雾会拖慢速度, 严寒会让蜂箱进入冬眠, 酷热则会消耗蜜蜂的体力.

UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenMissing.en: There is no queen in the hive.

UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleSealed1.cn: 取出一瓶. 需要一个空玻璃瓶, 以及一个软木塞或蜂蜡塞.

UI_HCB_MB_SayOneFruitProfile.cn: 这个桶一次只能备一种水果风味.

UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodWorking.en: The bees are calm and busy.

UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodWorking.cn: 蜜蜂很平静, 也很忙碌.

UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleNoneSealed.en: Nothing to bottle yet. Start a batch first.

UI_HCB_MB_TimelineAged.cn: 已熟成且浓烈 - %1 后会变质.

UI_HCB_GH_TipBiomeNeutral.en: A neutral biome - no effect on the hive.

UI_HCB_GH_TipBiomeNeutral.cn: 中性的生态环境 - 对蜂箱没有影响.

UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBoth.en: Abundant plant life and current biome are boosting your harvest.

UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBoth.cn: 茂盛的植被和当前的生态环境都在提升你的收获.

UI_HCB_GH_CondSnow.ch: 下雪讓所有工作都暫停了.
UI_HCB_GH_CondSnow.cn: 下雪让所有工作都暂停了.

UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyBottleNoRoom.en: There is not enough room left for a whole bottle of honey.

UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyBottleNoRoom.cn: 剩下的空间不够放一整瓶蜂蜜.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingEta.cn: 蜜蜂正在建造这块蜂巢. 大约还要 %1 小时才会填满.

UI_HCB_MB_TipStart1.en: Start the batch: %1 bottles from %2 honey, %3 water,

UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBiome.cn: 这种生态环境正在提升你的收获.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBee.en: A worker bee resting on her comb.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBee.ch: 一隻工蜂停在自己的蜂巢上休息.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBee.cn: 一只工蜂停在自己的蜂巢上休息.

UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyHoney.en: Bottle or finish the current batch before adding more honey.

UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyHoney.cn: 先把当前的批次装瓶或处理完, 再加更多蜂蜜.

UI_HCB_MB_TimelineSpoiled.cn: 已变质. 倒掉它, 或是自行承担风险装瓶.

UI_HCB_MB_TipYeast1.cn: 必需. 一个批次需要 %1 次用量的酵母.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S2b.cn: 你离开时它也会继续运行.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNotEnoughStaged.en: You need enough staged honey, water, and yeast to start at least 1.0 L.

UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineSpoiled.cn: %1 - 已变质. 倒掉它, 或是自行承担风险装瓶.

UI_HCB_Hive_NeedSugarWater.cn: 你身上需要有一些糖水 - 一罐糖水, 或任何你倒进糖水的容器.

UI_HCB_Hive_FeedRequiresSugarWater.cn: 需要一些糖水 - 一罐糖水, 或任何你倒进糖水的容器.

Moodles_KDDizy_Good_desc_lvl4.en: You have no repairs. The hell is happening

Moodles_KDFocused_Good_desc_lvl1.en: You're feeling more concentrated than usual

Moodles_KDFocused_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 你比平常更能集中注意力

Moodles_KDGoodTrip_Good_desc_lvl4.cn: 我即一切, 亦即虚无

Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 你头痛欲裂. 你当初到底在想什么.

Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl4.en: Never again. I mean it this time.
Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl4.ch: 再也不喝了. 這次是說真的.
Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl4.cn: 再也不喝了. 这次是说真的.

Moodles_KDLoosened_Good_desc_lvl2.en: Life seems not so bad now.

Moodles_KDNastyTrip_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: You feel a bit out of place

Moodles_KDNastyTrip_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: Things around you are strange but not in a positive way.
Moodles_KDNastyTrip_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 周遭的一切變得怪異, 而且不是好的那種.
Moodles_KDNastyTrip_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 周遭的一切变得怪异, 而且不是好的那种.

Moodles_KDNastyTrip_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: You starting to feel really uncomfortable

Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl1.en: A pleasant warmth spreads through your body.
Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 一股舒服的暖意流遍全身.
Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 一股舒服的暖意流遍全身.

Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl2.en: Your eyelids feel heavy... so heavy.

Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl3.en: You're somewhere between here and nowhere.
Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl3.ch: 你飄在此處與虛無之間.
Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl3.cn: 你飘在此处与虚无之间.

Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: Something doesn't feel right in your body.

Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl1.cn: 你的身体感觉不太对劲.

Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: Your heart is racing. Or is it stopping ?

Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl3.cn: 你几乎喘不过气. 情况很糟.

Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl1.en: You feel strangely calm and sleepy.
Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 你感到異樣的平靜與睏倦.
Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 你感到异样的平静与困倦.

Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl2.ch: 一切都變得緩慢而遙遠.
Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl2.cn: 一切都变得缓慢而遥远.

Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl3.en: Moving feels like swimming through concrete.
Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl3.ch: 動一下就像在水泥裡游泳.
Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl3.cn: 动一下就像在水泥里游泳.

Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl4.en: You can barely keep your eyes open.

Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl1.en: You feel a rush of energy you've never felt before.
Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 一股前所未有的能量衝上腦門.
Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 一股前所未有的能量冲上脑门.

Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl2.en: Your mind is racing. You can't stop moving.

Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl2.cn: 你的思绪狂奔. 停不下来.

Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl3.en: Your heart is pounding. Is that normal ?

Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl3.cn: 你的心脏猛烈跳动. 这正常吗?

Moodles_dtemallergy_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: Frequent sneezing and coughing, itching in various parts of the body. You feel pain from scratching.
Moodles_dtemallergy_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 頻繁打噴嚏和咳嗽, 身體多處發癢. 抓癢讓你感到疼痛.
Moodles_dtemallergy_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 频繁打喷嚏和咳嗽, 身体多处发痒. 抓痒让你感到疼痛.

Moodles_dtemallergy_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: Itching almost all over the body. The pain increases a lot.
Moodles_dtemallergy_Bad_desc_lvl3.ch: 幾乎全身發癢. 疼痛大幅加劇.
Moodles_dtemallergy_Bad_desc_lvl3.cn: 几乎全身发痒. 疼痛大幅加剧.

Moodles_dtemallergy_Bad_desc_lvl4.en: The allergy has taken over your whole body. You are suffocating, your fatigue, tiredness and health decrease.

Moodles_dtemallergy_Bad_desc_lvl4.cn: 过敏已经占据你的全身. 你呼吸困难, 体力、精神与健康持续下降.

Moodles_dtembloodlust_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: You start thinking about your next victim.

Moodles_dtembloodlust_Bad_desc_lvl1.cn: 你开始想着下一个猎物.

Moodles_dtembloodlust_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: Long time without killing anyone, your mood is affected.

Moodles_dtembloodlust_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 太久没杀过东西, 心情开始受到影响.

Moodles_dtembloodlust_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: Too long without killing anyone, your mood is affected even more.
Moodles_dtembloodlust_Bad_desc_lvl3.ch: 太久沒殺過東西了, 心情受到的影響更加嚴重.
Moodles_dtembloodlust_Bad_desc_lvl3.cn: 太久没杀过东西了, 心情受到的影响更加严重.

Moodles_dtembloodlust_Bad_desc_lvl4.en: In danger of developing permanent mood problems.
Moodles_dtembloodlust_Bad_desc_lvl4.ch: 有可能留下永久性的情緒問題.
Moodles_dtembloodlust_Bad_desc_lvl4.cn: 有可能留下永久性的情绪问题.

Moodles_dtemcaffeine_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: No caffeine in the body. You are in a bad mood.
Moodles_dtemcaffeine_Bad_desc_lvl1.ch: 體內沒有咖啡因. 你心情很差.
Moodles_dtemcaffeine_Bad_desc_lvl1.cn: 体内没有咖啡因. 你心情很差.

Moodles_dtemcaffeine_Good_desc_lvl1.en: Caffeine in the body. You are in a good mood.
Moodles_dtemcaffeine_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 體內有咖啡因. 你心情很好.
Moodles_dtemcaffeine_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 体内有咖啡因. 你心情很好.

Moodles_dtemoverdose_Bad_desc_lvl4.ch: 嚴重中毒, 有死亡危險.
Moodles_dtemoverdose_Bad_desc_lvl4.cn: 严重中毒, 有死亡危险.

Moodles_BodilyFumes_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: A faint, unpleasant whiff of something human lingers nearby.
Moodles_BodilyFumes_Bad_desc_lvl1.ch: 附近飄著一絲淡淡的, 令人不快的人味.
Moodles_BodilyFumes_Bad_desc_lvl1.cn: 附近飘着一丝淡淡的, 令人不快的人味.

Moodles_BodilyFumes_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: A strong stench of gas or fluids hits your nose. Someone definitely let loose.
Moodles_BodilyFumes_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 一股濃烈的氣體或體液臭味直衝鼻腔. 肯定是有人沒憋住.

Moodles_BodilyFumes_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: The air reeks of expelled gas or fluids. You can almost taste it.
Moodles_BodilyFumes_Bad_desc_lvl3.ch: 空氣中瀰漫著排出的氣體或體液惡臭. 你幾乎能嚐到味道.
Moodles_BodilyFumes_Bad_desc_lvl3.cn: 空气中弥漫着排出的气体或体液恶臭. 你几乎能尝到味道.

Moodles_BodilyFumes_Bad_desc_lvl4.en: The air's thick with the stench of expelled bodily fluids. You might hurl.
Moodles_BodilyFumes_Bad_desc_lvl4.ch: 空氣中的排洩物臭味濃得化不開. 你可能會吐出來.
Moodles_BodilyFumes_Bad_desc_lvl4.cn: 空气中的排泄物臭味浓得化不开. 你可能会吐出来.

Moodles_Defecation_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: Your bowels are making their presence known.
Moodles_Defecation_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 你的腸道開始刷存在感了.
Moodles_Defecation_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 你的肠道开始刷存在感了.

Moodles_Defecation_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: The need to go is becoming unbearable.

Moodles_PeedSelf_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: It’s uncomfortable, but you can still manage.
Moodles_PeedSelf_Bad_desc_lvl1.ch: 有點不舒服, 但還撐得住.
Moodles_PeedSelf_Bad_desc_lvl1.cn: 有点不舒服, 但还撑得住.

Moodles_PeedSelf_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: Can't blame it on spilled water.
Moodles_PeedSelf_Bad_desc_lvl3.ch: 這可沒辦法推說是水灑了.
Moodles_PeedSelf_Bad_desc_lvl3.cn: 这可没办法推说是水洒了.

Moodles_PoopedSelf_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: It's not horrible, but it's definitely noticeable.
Moodles_PoopedSelf_Bad_desc_lvl1.ch: 還沒到糟糕的地步, 但絕對藏不住.
Moodles_PoopedSelf_Bad_desc_lvl1.cn: 还没到糟糕的地步, 但绝对藏不住.

Moodles_PoopedSelf_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: Your pants will not forgive you.

Moodles_PoopedSelf_Bad_desc_lvl4.ch: 絕對不能再發生第二次.
Moodles_PoopedSelf_Bad_desc_lvl4.cn: 绝对不能再发生第二次.

Moodles_Urination_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 你的膀胱開始鬧脾氣了.
Moodles_Urination_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 你的膀胱开始闹脾气了.

Moodles_Urination_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: The need to go is impossible to ignore.

_rule_cn: 【cn 欄鐵律】cn 必須與 ch 同等對待——逐鍵對照 en 原文直寫大陸慣用簡中，**禁止用 opencc / t2s 或任何簡繁轉換器整批產生**。理由：t2s 只換字形不換詞彙，產出的是「字是簡體、詞是台灣說法」，簡中讀者一眼看得出來；而且有一類錯誤所有 gate 都攔不到——助詞「著」在簡化字表中存在（著名/著作/顯著/土著），所以「抱著」轉完仍是「抱著」，大陸須寫「抱着」。2026-08-08 全庫稽核實證：抽樣 63 鍵就抓到 16 個詞級分歧，全庫掃出 595 鍵需修正（洋装→连衣裙、运作→运行、点选→点击、后车厢→后备箱、抱著→抱着…）。歷史債：現存 own 鍵中約 18,822 鍵（68%）為當時 t2s 產物，已做過一輪詞級稽核，但那是事後補救不是替代方案；**新增鍵一律逐筆撰寫**。機械防線：verify [14] own 層 CN 用字（擋 著/牠/妳/「」），詞級在地化無法機械判定，靠本規則。
